4532149020787.desc: Gamera (1999) from the critically acclaimed kaiju film, Gamera 3: Revenge of Iris, released in 1999, makes its debut as a 1/700 scale plastic model! The knowledge and experience gained from various series, such as the Daikaiju and DefoReal series, has been poured into this plastic model of Gamera (1999) that stands at approximately 11.5cm tall and features details which have been carefully condensed. Additionally, being a 1/700 scale model, it can work well with countless other models to create a truly impressive collection. The mouth can be reproduced open or closed by replacing the chin part.This model also features the shell, Gamera’s most distinctive feature, which has had all its parts molded piece by piece. Simply assembling it will immediately make it feel much more dimensional! Don’t miss this chance to get your hands on Gamera (1999), the very first kaiju plastic model featured in this series! Also, be sure to look out for new developments for this series in the future! Plastic Model Kit

4532149021005.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4532149021005.short: This model kit captures the chained creature from Revenge of the Creature, featuring detailed hands, a faithful head design, and lively fish in an underwater diorama. Exclusive to Shonen Ric, it includes an additional closed-mouth head.
4532149021005.desc:
After being captured and displayed as a sideshow attraction in the ocean harbor oceanarium in Florida, the creature, is determined to escape and seek his retribution.

This model is a motif inspired by the memorable scene in the first sequel to Creature from the Black Lagoon in which the captured creature can be seen chained up in a large aquarium. Some of the features of this kit are as follows:

Meticulously Sculpted Hands

Hands so symbolic that they can be repeatedly seen throughout the film. Their subtle details can clearly be seen in this highly detailed reproduction.

A Head that Stays True to the Source Material

Note the details of this version from Revenge of the Creature, the second installment in a three-part series, with its distinctive eyes and delicately formed gills.

Lively Fish

This kit also comes with some of Florida’s lively inhabitants, the French Angelfish seen swimming in the tank with the captured creature.

Realistic Diorama

Utilize the diorama base to enjoy a motif reminiscent of the flourishing underwater environs of Florida.

*Shonen Ric Exclusive: Includes the extra head with closed mouth!

4532149021227.short: This 1/35 scale Spinosaurus model kit from Jurassic Park III features a dynamic, lifelike pose and a diorama base inspired by the film's climax, showcasing the dinosaur's impressive size and ferocity.
4532149021227.desc:
"The Arrival of a New Predator"

From the 2001 "Jurassic Park III," the Spinosaurus left a powerful impression as the "dinosaur that defeated the T. Rex" and we have brought this large, strong, and ferocious theropod to life in a 1/35 scale plastic model kit.

"Capturing Lifelike Expressions Unique to Plastic Models"

As this is a plastic model kit that offers both lightweight construction and durability, we've carefully selected dynamic poses that effectively convey a sense of 'motion.' Notably, the highlight is the challenging single-legged stance, a pose often deemed challenging for polystatues or PVC figures.

"Impressive 1/35 Scale"

The kit includes a diorama base that draws inspiration from the movie's climactic scene. When you compare the size of the sunken crane to that of the Spinosaurus, you'll gain a profound appreciation for the sheer magnitude of this carnivorous dinosaur. Take note of the remarkable portrayal of size, a characteristic unique to scale models.

*Actual product does not come assembled or painted. The image is taken from the assembled finished product of the model kit. The finished product may look different from the picture.

4532149021531.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4532149021531.short: This 1/35 scale T-Rex model kit captures the iconic Jurassic Park scene with detailed plastic parts and dynamic posing. An exclusive Donald Gennaro figure is included in the special edition.
4532149021531.desc:
One of the Largest Land Predators Brought Back from Extinction

Meet the T-Rex that made its way onto the big screen in the 1993 film "Jurassic Park". The visitors of "Jurassic Park" were left sitting wide-eyed and paralyzed with fear as this “true dinosaur” made its way to the main road of the tour as the ground trembled beneath its feet. This plastic model kit will bring its collectors the thrill and perhaps even dread that they felt whenn they witnessed this scene for the first time.

An Impressive 1/35 Scale

It has been produced in 1/35 scale, the standard for military models. One will be able to truly feel the immense size of the T-Rex’s impressive scale towering next to the famous Dr. Ian Malcom.

Bringing You That Signature Plastic Model Kit Feel

All parts have been broken down and manufactured with high qualiy molds to capture the T-Rex’s proportions and intricate details seen in its skin.

Plastic became the material of choice thanks to being light weight and highly durable, allowing for the model to be posed standing on one leg which can be a challenging pose to achieve when using PVC or poly resin.  Collectors will be able to enjoy the organic feel that this model gives off as the thigh muscles visibly contract as she lift her legs up and shifts her weight to one side.

Straight Out of the Movie

We’ve recreated the scene from the film where T-Rex is being lured away with flares as a diorama.  This world where one can be seen with prehistoric beasts, rail-lined roads and electrified fences is one that can only be made possible through the universe of “Jurassic Park” where dinosaurs have been born once again into the modern age through technology.

Exclusive Part

A 1/35 scale model of Donald Gennaro will be included in the Exclusive version. Right before he is T-Rex's dinner!

4545784012611.short: Max Factory releases a 150mm PLAMAX plastic model kit of the Iron Giant, based on the 1986 soft vinyl kit, with detailed parts and a poseable design inspired by the box art.
4545784012611.desc: Max Factory is bringing the Iron Giant back in PLAMAX form! Following PLAMAX Sirbine, Max Factory presents a second PLAMAX plastic model kit based on legendary kits from the past. Each part of the original Iron Giant soft vinyl kit released in 1986 has been 3D scanned and recreated in 150mm fixed pose plastic model form. The casted appearance of the parts on its front and the special shield part made for the soft vinyl kit have been faithfully recreated. The pose of the model has been reconfigured to fit that of the box art—a pose only possible through the injection molding process used to create plastic model parts. Be sure to add this plastic model of Iron Giant to your collection! *Plastic model tools and adhesive are required for assembly. *Use paint appropriate for plastic models when painting.

She has been faithfully recreated in plastic model form with a high level of detail. Using the 5 different colored runners, Deedlit can easily be recreated just by putting the model kit together. 4545784067871.desc: The figma of the leader of the Specialized Extracurricular Execution Squad (S.E.E.S) is coming back for a rerelease! From "Persona 3 The Movie" comes a rerelease of the figma of the main character, Makoto Yuki! · Using the smooth yet posable joints of figma, you can act out a variety of different scenes. · A flexible plastic is used for important areas, allowing proportions to be kept without compromising posability. · He comes with three face plates including an expressionless face, a confident summoning face as well as a gentle smile. · Optional parts include his 'Evoker' summoning gun, a S.E.E.S armband, interchangeable pants parts that include a holster as well as a single-handed sword. · An articulated figma stand is included, which allows various poses to be taken.

4545784067895.short: A posable figma of Alice Synthesis Thirty from Sword Art Online Alicization: War of Underworld, featuring multiple facial expressions, optional weapons, and effect parts for dynamic display.
4545784067895.desc: "In order to accomplish what I must do, I will fight you!" From the popular anime series "Sword Art Online Alicization: War of Underworld" comes a figma of Alice Synthesis Thirty! An articulated figma stand is included to display the figma in a variety of poses.

Using the smooth yet posable joints of figma, you can create a variety of action-packed poses from the series. A flexible plastic is used for important areas, allowing proportions to be kept without compromising posability. He comes with three face plates including a standard face, a smiling face and an injured combat face. Forward-looking, left-looking and right-looking eye parts for use with his standard face and smiling face are also included. As for optional parts, he comes with his Nichirin Blade and three kinds of flame effect parts for recreating his Flame Breathing techniques. An articulated figma stand is included to display the figma in a variety of poses. *Also available: figma Akaza*

A Frizz Cracker magic effect part is also included. An articulated figma stand is included to display the figma in a variety of poses.

Presenting a figma of a new Snow Miku that paints the morning sky, featuring a cute and fluffy design.

2023 marks the 14th anniversary of Snow Miku, and the 2023 design was once again selected by fans through online votes between a selection of outfits all submitted to piapro by fans! This year the theme was "Clouds and Skies of the Hokkaido Winter", and the winning Snow Miku design was this version based on illustrations by Isakytm! The figma also comes with Rabbit Yukine in a matching outfit.

Using the smooth yet posable joints of figma, you can create a variety of poses.

A flexible plastic is used for important areas, allowing proportions to be kept without compromising posability.

She comes with three face plates including a standard face, an adorable smiling face and a singing face with closed eyes.

A large brush and miniature figure of Rabbit Yukine are included as optional parts. Enjoy using them to create different poses and situations!

An articulated figma stand is included to display the figma in a variety of poses.

4571335883980.short: Wolverine joins the Fighting Armor line in a highly articulated suit designed to mimic human movement, with die-cast parts for added weight and an adjustable display stand.
4571335883980.desc:
"What if… Tony Stark integrates each of the Avengers' super power into an armor?"

Mitsunari Otenfu handles design and rearrangement while Hiroyuki Komatsubara manages prototype making and project direction. Wolverine is rejoining the Fighting Armor line-up!

In this innovative series, the human body will be covered in a "suit" while each joint is carefully designed in pursuit of articulation as close as possible to that of a true human body.

Die-cast is used in various parts to reproduce a sense of heaviness. An adjustable display stand is also included for aerial poses.

Don't miss out on adding this Canadian X-Men to your collection and order yours today!

4573102554550.desc:
The formidable MSN-06S Sinanju Stein Ver. Ka arrives as a Master Grade model kit, showcasing the prototype Psycho-Frame mobile suit from the Mobile Suit Gundam UC MSV project. Designed by the renowned Hajime Katoki, this kit meticulously captures the Sinanju Stein's original, unmodified form before its transformation for the Neo Zeon remnants, the Sleeves. It's an intermediate to advanced build, offering a rewarding experience for seasoned modelers with its detailed inner frame and Katoki-designed marking decals.

Experience unparalleled posing thanks to the advanced Emotion Manipulator SP hands, featuring fully articulated finger joints for expressive gestures and a secure grip on weaponry with a double-locking mechanism. The entire inner frame is constructed from polystyrene (PS) plastic, a thoughtful engineering choice that mitigates the risk of peg breakage sometimes encountered with earlier Sinanju kits. Double-jointed construction in both the elbows and knees allows for deep bending and dynamic, lifelike poses. Forearm beam saber racks, styled after those in Gundam Unicorn, slide open and close to reveal the stored beam sabers. Rear leg thrusters are independently movable, utilizing link arms for an expanded range of motion.

This kit includes water transfer marking decals, designed by Hajime Katoki, allowing for a highly detailed and authentic finish.

Included Equipment and Accessories:

- MSN-06S Sinanju Stein mobile suit

- Beam Rifle

- Rocket Bazooka

- Shield (with integrated beam cannon and missiles)

- 2 Beam Sabers

- Emotion Manipulator SP hand parts

- 1/100 scale Full Frontal figurine (sitting)

- 1/100 scale Full Frontal figurine (standing)

- Adapter for Action Base 1

- Foil sticker sheet x1

- Water transfer marking decal sheet x1

- Instruction manual

4573102573810.short: The HG 1/144 R11 LaGOWE is a highly detailed, poseable model of Andrew Waltfeld's iconic Mobile Suit from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, featuring transformable design, a rotating back-mounted cannon, and clear beam saber blades. The kit includes colored parts, stickers, and snap-together assembly with no
4573102573810.desc:
Command the desert battlefield with the HG 1/144 R11 LaGOWE, Andrew Waltfeld's iconic Mobile Suit from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED. This highly detailed High Grade model kit brings the formidable "Desert Tiger" machine to life, specialized for desert combat operations.

Experience exceptional posing flexibility thanks to individually articulated legs, allowing for dynamic stances. The LaGOWE is also capable of transforming into its cruising mode, ready to traverse sandy terrains. Its signature back-mounted cannon features both rotation and elevation movement gimmicks, while the beam saber blades are reproduced with clear parts for a striking visual effect. Realistic soft rubber material is used for the caterpillar tracks, adding to the authenticity of this unique quadrupedal design.

This snap-together kit requires no glue for assembly, and its colored plastic parts mean little to no paint is needed to replicate its on-screen appearance.

Included in the box:

- Molded parts x 6

- Foil sticker x 1

- Marking sticker x 1

- Lead wire x 1

- Instruction manual x 1

Specifications:

- Scale: 1/144

- Material: Plastic, Rubber

- Series: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED

4573102573865.short: Assemble the highly detailed Gundam AGE-3 Normal from Mobile Suit Gundam AGE in 1/144 scale with this snap-fit model kit. It features transformable parts for Core Fighter and G-Cepter modes, minimal stickers, and includes weapons and display stand.

4573102573889.short: The High Grade 1/144 Gundam AGE-FX model kit features detailed C-Funnels, a clear ring display stand, and a removable Core Fighter for dynamic poses. It includes multiple hands, a transformable rifle, and translucent parts for vibrant color.
4573102573889.desc:
Experience the ultimate form of the AGE System with the High Grade 1/144 Gundam AGE-FX, a standout model kit from BANDAI HOBBY. This highly articulated kit captures the dynamic presence of the AGE-FX from the "Mobile Suit Gundam AGE" series, allowing for a wide range of expressive poses once completed.

The Gundam AGE-FX is renowned for its C-Funnels, and this kit faithfully recreates their iconic "Full Burst Mode" with a clear ring display stand. Position the numerous effect parts to showcase the mobile suit's devastating offensive capabilities. The kit also features a removable Core Fighter, adding to its authenticity and playability.

Crafted from durable plastic, this model kit is designed for effortless assembly without the need for glue, providing a straightforward and high-quality building experience. Translucent plastic and foil stickers are included to help recreate the vibrant colors of the mobile suit.

Included in the box:

- Pieces to build the HG 1/144 Gundam AGE-FX

- Clear ring effect part display stand for C-Funnels

- Stungle Rifle, which transforms into the Daidal Bazooka

- Removable Core Fighter

- 14 C-Funnels (6 large, 8 small)

- Interchangeable hands (2 closed fists, 2 weapon-holding hands, 1 open left hand)

- Instruction manual

Specifications:

- Scale: 1/144

- Material: Plastic (PS)

- Series: Mobile Suit Gundam AGE

- Manufacturer: BANDAI HOBBY

4573102575760.desc:
Command the battlefield with the High Grade 1/144 Zaku II Type C-6/R6, a meticulously detailed model kit from BANDAI HOBBY, bringing to life the iconic mobile suit from Mobile Suit Gundam: The Origin. This kit captures the enhanced armor and weaponry of the C-6 type, further augmented by the optional R6 kit armaments, making it a formidable addition to any collection.

This Zaku II features a newly molded chest with a Vulcan Gun, along with distinct shoulder design markings that allow you to recreate the machines of Falmer Squadron members such as Denim, Slender, Gene, and Pacheco. The advanced articulation ensures dynamic posing, letting you recreate memorable scenes or craft your own unique displays. Customization options are plentiful, allowing builders to configure the Zaku II in either C-6 or R6 specifications, including various shoulder designs and backpack types.

Included in this kit are a comprehensive array of armaments to equip your Zaku II for any engagement:

- Belt-fed Zaku machine gun

- Bazooka with two detachable magazines

- Anti-Ship rifle

- Heat Hawk (extended and stored forms)

- Optional commander fin antenna head

- Optional standard shoulder armor

- Optional chest parts

- Stickers for unit numbers (101-105) and additional detailing

- Multiple hand options, including an open left hand and trigger finger hand

Specifications:

- Material: PS, PE Plastic

4573102577504.desc:
Experience the iconic XXXG-01W Wing Gundam from the beloved Mobile Suit Gundam Wing series in a fantastic 1/144 High Grade After Colony (HGAC) model kit. This rendition captures the mobile suit's sleek design and powerful presence with modern proportions and superior articulation, making it a standout addition to any Gunpla collection.

A highlight of this kit is its ability to seamlessly transform into its high-speed Bird Mode, offering dynamic display options. The model boasts excellent color separation, providing a largely color-accurate representation straight out of the box, with minimal need for additional paint for key details. Its advanced articulation allows for a wide range of expressive poses, recreating memorable scenes from the anime.

The Wing Gundam comes equipped with its signature armaments, ready for any engagement. The shield features a clever gimmick, able to open and reveal a stored beam saber handle. Thoughtful engineering extends to the forearms, where claws are designed to move out of the way, ensuring a full and unhindered bend at the elbow.

Specifications:

- Scale: 1/144

- Height: Approximately 13 cm (5.1 inches)

- Material: Pre-colored plastic (Polystyrene)

- Assembly: Snap-fit, no glue required

Included:

- Wing Gundam model kit

- Buster Rifle

- Wing Shield

- 2 Beam Sabers (with clear green blades)

- Foil stickers

- Instruction manual

The kit is designed to faithfully reproduce two distinct forms of the Gundam Barbatos as seen in the series, offering versatility in display. 4573102582058.short: Celebrate 40 years of Gunpla with the HG RX-78-2 GUNDAM [BEYOND GLOBAL], featuring enhanced articulation, dynamic posing, and a refined design. This snap-fit kit includes a beam rifle, shield, and sabers, with minimal painting required.
4573102582058.desc:
A celebration of 40 years of Gunpla, the HG 1/144 RX-78-2 GUNDAM [BEYOND GLOBAL] brings the iconic RX-78-2 Gundam, as designed by Kunio Okawara, to life with unparalleled articulation and refined proportions. This kit represents the culmination of High Grade series technology, meticulously balancing dynamic posing capabilities with a beautiful, updated aesthetic.

Experience natural and dynamic movements thanks to numerous advanced gimmicks integrated throughout the model. The fuselage features a forward-bending and swing-movable structure, complemented by a neck shaft that moves both front and back. Newly added inner thigh joints facilitate human-like kneeling and expansive stances, while independent wrist articulation ensures fluid shield movement and expressive hand poses. A ball-jointed wrist block further enhances natural hand motion for powerful, lifelike gestures. Hip joints swing widely forward and backward, supported by movable rear skirt armor for maximum flexibility. Even the shoulder blade-like side chest blocks move outward, preserving aesthetic lines during dynamic arm movements.

This snap-fit model kit requires no glue for assembly, making it an accessible and enjoyable build for enthusiasts. The parts are molded in color, and excellent color separation means minimal painting is needed for a fantastic display. The helmet is even molded in a single piece, eliminating unsightly seam lines.

Included Accessories:

- Beam Rifle x1

- Shield x1

- Beam Sabers x2

- Foil Sticker sheet x1

- Alternate hand parts (trigger finger right, open palm left)

Specifications:

- Scale: 1/144

- Height: Approximately 4.92 inches (12.5cm)

- Material: PS Plastic

- Series: Mobile Suit Gundam

- Manufacturer: BANDAI HOBBY

4573102587794.short: The 1/144 HGCE Aile Strike Gundam is a detailed model kit featuring improved articulation, a detachable Aile Striker pack, and multiple weapons, ideal for display or dynamic posing.
4573102587794.desc:
Relive the iconic moments of Mobile Suit Gundam SEED with the 1/144 HGCE Aile Strike Gundam, a highly detailed High Grade Cosmic Era (HGCE) model kit from BANDAI HOBBY. This rendition of the Aile Strike Gundam brings a modern interpretation to the beloved mobile suit, featuring updated proportions and an impressive range of motion for dynamic posing.

Part of the "All Gundam Project," this kit incorporates a new poly-cap joint system, making assembly more intuitive and enhancing articulation compared to previous versions. The redesigned Aile Striker pack is detachable and boasts articulated binders and movable wings, allowing for versatile display options. Whether recreating intense aerial combat or a grounded stance, the Aile Strike Gundam offers a satisfying build and a striking display piece for any Gundam enthusiast.

4573102587824.short: The 1/100 Saviour Gundam model kit from BANDAI HOBBY features a snap-fit, pre-colored design for easy assembly and dynamic posing. It includes transformation from Mobile Suit to Mobile Armor mode and comes with detailed armaments.
4573102587824.desc:
Command the skies with the 1/100 #14 Saviour Gundam, a highly anticipated model kit from BANDAI HOBBY, bringing Athrun Zala's iconic transformable Mobile Suit from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny to your collection. This impressive 1/100 scale kit accurately captures the sleek design and formidable capabilities of the ZGMF-X23S Saviour Gundam, known for its high-speed aerial combat prowess and versatile transformation.

Experience the thrill of building as this kit features snap-fit assembly, eliminating the need for glue, and boasts pre-colored plastic parts, so painting is not required to achieve a stunning display. The Saviour Gundam is engineered for dynamic posing and seamless transformation, allowing you to recreate its various combat stances and its distinctive Mobile Armor mode.

Key features of this 1/100 scale model include:

- Full transformation capability from Mobile Suit mode to its fighter jet-like Mobile Armor mode through minor parts rearrangement.

- Exceptional articulation with double-jointed elbows and knees, enabling a wide range of expressive poses.

- Ball-and-socket joints in the head, manipulators, and hips for enhanced movement.

- A 360-degree rotating waist and independently pivoting front and side skirt armor to prevent interference during posing.

- Detailed gimmicks, such as the head antenna and lower arm armor, are thoroughly reproduced to ensure an accurate transformation.

Included in the kit are all the signature armaments of the Saviour Gundam, ready for display:

- ZGMF-X23S Saviour Gundam main body

- Beam Rifle

- Beam Saber x2, featuring clear parts for a realistic effect

- Aerodynamic Shield

- Adapter for shield mounting

- Sticker decal sheet for added detail

Specifications:

- Scale: 1/100

- Materials: PS, PE, ABS

- Overall height (Mobile Suit mode): Approximately 18.61 meters (in-universe)

4573102588890.desc:
Command the battlefield with the iconic MSN-04 Sazabi, brought to life in this High Grade Universal Century 1/144 scale model kit from BANDAI HOBBY. Piloted by Char Aznable in Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack, this kit faithfully recreates the mobile suit's imposing, heavy armor and Newtype-use funnel weaponry.

Experience a rewarding build with a snap-fit assembly system that requires no glue, making it suitable for builders of all skill levels. New polycap joints throughout the model enhance posability, allowing for dynamic display options.

Key Features:

- Recreates the Sazabi's massive presence with thick armor plating.

- Movable mono-eye sensor (requires removal of the upper head).

- Elbow and knee joints bend up to 90 degrees for extensive articulation.

- Shoulder joints swing forward, expanding posing possibilities.

- Backpack-mounted funnel racks open and close, revealing stored funnels.

- Poseable fuel tanks add to the model's dynamic silhouette.

- Shield attaches in two different positions via a versatile 2-way adapter.

- Beam Tomahawk includes both tomahawk and sword effect parts for varied attack poses.

- Beam Tomahawk hilt can be conveniently stored within the shield.

- Compatible with Action Base 1 and Action Base 4 (sold separately) for aerial displays.

Included Items:

- MSN-04 Sazabi model kit

- Beam Shot Rifle

- 2 Beam Sabers

- Shield

- 2-Way Adapter for shield

- Beam Tomahawk

- Tomahawk Effect Part

- Sword Effect Part

- 6 Funnels (deployed mode)

- Hand Parts (weapon-holding pair, trigger-finger right hand, open palm left hand)

- Sticker Sheet

- Instruction Manual

Specifications:

- Scale: 1/144

- Height: Approximately 8 inches (20.32 cm)

- Material: PS, PE, and PVC plastic

Dive into the world of Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny with the HGCE 1/144 Infinite Justice Gundam, a highly anticipated High Grade Cosmic Era model kit. 4573102592286.short: The Real Grade 1/144 ZGMF-X56S/α Force Impulse Gundam from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny features detailed articulation, transformable parts, and realistic mechanical elements, including the Core Splendor and α Force Silhouette. It includes multiple weapons, interchangeable hands, and a Shinn Asuk
4573102592286.desc:
From the iconic Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny series, the Real Grade 1/144 ZGMF-X56S/α Force Impulse Gundam arrives, meticulously engineered by BANDAI HOBBY. This kit captures the transformable and combinable nature of the Impulse Gundam with unparalleled detail and articulation, bringing Shinn Asuka's powerful mobile suit to life on your display shelf.

Experience the innovative Advanced MS Joint system, featuring insert molding in the Core Splendor and main body. This allows for the internal frame and body frame to be detached from the runners in an assembled state, providing intricate mechanical details and dynamic movement gimmicks right out of the box. The color reproduction is enhanced through precise parts division, accurately representing the subtle variations in hue between adjacent armor panels.

The Force Impulse Gundam boasts exceptional articulation, with double-jointed elbows and knees, forearms that twist on a separate axis from the elbows, and independently rotating shoulder armor to minimize interference. The waist parts move in blocks, ensuring a wide range of motion, while the hip axis can be pulled down for even greater posing flexibility. The Force Silhouette, designed with real-world aircraft in mind, features wings that fold backward, adding to its realistic appeal.

- RG 1/144 ZGMF-X56S/α Force Impulse Gundam model kit

- Core Splendor

- α Force Silhouette pack

- Silhouette Flyer

- High-energy Beam Rifle

- Mobile Shield (expandable)

- Vajra Beam Sabers (x2)

- Folding Razor Anti-armor Knives (x2)

- Multiple interchangeable hand parts (fists, weapon-holding, open-palm)

- 3 landing gears for Core Splendor

- 1 pair of 6-tube Anti-air Missile Launchers

- Action Base Adapters for Chest Flyer and Impulse Gundam/Leg Flyer

- 1/144 Shinn Asuka figurine

- Newly designed realistic decals

Specifications:

- Assembly: Snap-fit, no glue required

- Painting: Molded in color, no paint required

4573102592347.desc:
Experience the iconic Mobile Suit from the second season of Mobile Suit Gundam 00 with the High Grade 1/144 #22 00 Gundam model kit from BANDAI HOBBY. This highly sought-after Gunpla captures the striking design and dynamic capabilities of Setsuna F. Seiei's powerful mobile suit, making it a fantastic addition for both new builders and seasoned collectors.

Once assembled, this 00 Gundam becomes a fully articulated figure, ready for a wide array of heroic poses. Its design incorporates advanced polycapped joints, allowing for an expanded range of movement and ideal proportions that emphasize fascinating style over pure action. The highly articulated GN Twin Drive backpack is faithfully recreated, with flexible GN Drives on both shoulders that move along with the vertical movement of the frame, adding to its dynamic appearance.

The kit features parts molded in color, eliminating the need for paint to achieve a great-looking model right out of the box, though painting can enhance its realistic appearance. No glue is required for assembly, making the building process straightforward and enjoyable. Clear parts are effectively utilized at key points, further enhancing its visual appeal.

What's Included:

- HG 1/144 00 Gundam model kit

- Two (2) GN Sword II weapons, capable of transforming between sword and rifle modes

- Sheet of foil stickers

- Facial expression flat parts

- Instruction manual (note: instructions may or may not include English translation)

4573102616142.short: The RG 1/144 #05 Freedom Gundam is a highly detailed and articulated model kit from BANDAI HOBBY, featuring realistic design, advanced joint mechanics, and a range of included weapons and accessories for dynamic posing and display.
4573102616142.desc:
The RG 1/144 #05 Freedom Gundam brings the iconic Mobile Suit from the Mobile Suit Gundam SEED series to life with exceptional detail and articulation. This Real Grade model kit from BANDAI HOBBY is engineered to provide a realistic building experience and a stunning finished display piece.

Experience a thorough sense of realism, with the wing shape based on actual machine examination and the dynamic movement of its advanced inner frame. The kit features a flexible pre-molded frame and complementary colored armor parts, ensuring an impressive level of detail and color separation right out of the box. Realistic decals are included to simulate the intricate placement of maintenance hatches and ports, enhancing its authentic appearance.

Once assembled, the Freedom Gundam becomes a fully articulated figure, capable of recreating its most dynamic poses. Its advanced MS Joint system allows for an ultimate range of motion and mechanical detail. Recreate the powerful "High-Matte Mode" and the devastating "Full Burst Mode," showcasing the suit's full armament. The signature wings are designed to split into seven flaps in RG design, adding to the visual impact of its combat modes.

Included in the box:

- Pieces to build the Freedom Gundam

- Lupus Beam Rifle, which can be attached to the shield or extended with a stock

- 2 Rakerta Beam Sabers with clear beam effect parts, capable of connecting to form a double-bladed beam saber, and can be stored on the waist

- Laminated Anti-Beam Shield, mountable on the arm

- 2 Safias Rail Cannons, foldable on the hips and deployable for firing

- 2 Bolena Plasma Beam Cannons, hidden within the wings and flippable over the shoulders for attack

- Mini pilot figure of Kira Yamato

- Interchangeable hands, including closed fists, movable finger hands, a right trigger finger hand, and an open left hand

- Realistic marking stickers (two sheets)

- Instructions

- Joint piece for an action base (action base sold separately)

Specifications:

- Scale: 1/144

- Material: Plastic

- Assembly: Unassembled plastic model kit. No glue is required for assembly, but a hobby nipper is needed to remove parts from runners.

4573102616197.short: The Real Grade Mobile Suit Sinanju features detailed engineering, flexible thrusters, gold-plated engravings, and a glossy red finish, with extensive articulation and included weapons and accessories for dynamic display.
4573102616197.desc:
The crimson Mobile Suit Sinanju, piloted by the enigmatic Full Frontal from "Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn RE:0096", makes a stunning entry into the Real Grade lineup. This kit captures the elegant yet menacing presence of the Neo Zeon antagonist machine, showcasing Bandai's advanced 1/144 scale engineering with intricate detail and exceptional articulation.

Experience the brilliance of the Sinanju's design with its faithfully recreated features. The flexible rear-mounted thrusters are engineered with movable gimmicks, inspired by real rocket engine thrust control mechanisms, allowing them to open and close while revealing internal details. The iconic golden engravings of the Sleeves insignia are meticulously reproduced as individual gold-plated parts, providing an embossed appearance with superior detail, rather than relying on stickers. The main body armor is cast in a glossy red injection plastic, delivering a brilliant, eye-catching finish straight out of the box. High-density mechanical details, drawn by master designer Hajime Katoki, are reflected throughout the entire model, enhancing its realism and complexity. This Real Grade kit also utilizes pre-molded inner frame pieces, combining hard and soft plastics for large movable joint sections, ensuring extensive articulation for dynamic posing. The mono-eye sensor can be adjusted left or right via a hidden switch beneath the removable upper head panel.

- MSN-06S Sinanju runner set (16 runners)

- Shield

- Grenade Launcher (attachable to beam rifle or shield)

- Beam Saber x2

- Beam Axe x2 (can combine to form Beam Naginata)

- Beam Effect Parts

- Interchangeable hands

- Realistic decal sheet

- 1/144 Full Frontal Figure

- Action Base Adapter

- Instruction manual

4573102616623.short: The GAT-X131 Calamity Gundam from the FULL MECHANICS line offers high detail and poseability in 1/100 scale, featuring snap-fit plastic construction, advanced articulation, and included weapons like the Ram Cannon shield and Plasma-Sabot Bazooka.
4573102616623.desc:
The heavy artillery mobile suit GAT-X131 Calamity Gundam from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED arrives as the inaugural release in the revitalized FULL MECHANICS line, bringing an unprecedented level of detail and articulation to the 1/100 scale. This snap-fit plastic model kit captures the formidable design of the mobile suit piloted by Biological CPU Orga Sabnak, known for its devastating long-range fire support capabilities.

Experience MG-level mechanical detailing throughout the body, featuring intricate panel lines and sculpted armor sections that surpass its anime depiction. The kit boasts advanced articulation with double-jointed elbows and knees, ball-and-socket manipulators, and a swinging abdomen axis, allowing for a wide array of dynamic action poses. A pull-out head gimmick with a collar buffer further enhances posing freedom. All joints are constructed using durable plastic-on-plastic connections, ensuring sturdy joint strength and long-lasting pose retention without the need for polycaps.

The Calamity Gundam comes equipped with its signature weaponry, each designed for maximum poseability. The Kaefer Zwei Anti-beam Shield features independently swinging Ram Cannon barrels and a sliding grip for versatile handheld use. The rear port offers compatibility with various MG backpack units, including the MG Freedom Gundam Ver. 2.0 backpack, MG Justice Gundam Fatum-00, and Striker Packs via the MG Force Impulse adapter (sold separately), expanding customization options. This kit is suitable for beginner to intermediate builders, assembling without glue or paint for a color-accurate display straight out of the box.

Included Equipment and Accessories:

- GAT-X131 Calamity Gundam model kit

- Manipulators with interchangeable finger digits (default weapon-holding pair and trigger-finger right hand)

- Todesblock 337mm Plasma-Sabot Bazooka

- Kaefer Zwei 115mm 2-Barrel Ram Cannon Anti-beam Shield

- Action Base adapter

- Foil seal sheet

- Marking sticker sheet

4573102630513.short: The Master Grade ZGMF-X13A Providence Gundam features detailed articulation, detachable DRAGOON pods, and a composite shield with beam weapons. It includes a Rau Le Creuset pilot figure and is built without glue for an advanced model-building experience.
4573102630513.desc:
The formidable ZGMF-X13A Providence Gundam from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED arrives in the Master Grade lineup, capturing the imposing presence of Rau Le Creuset's iconic mobile suit. This highly detailed 1/100 scale model kit is engineered for both impressive display and dynamic posing, built upon the acclaimed internal frame structure shared with the MG Freedom Gundam Ver. 2.0, ensuring balanced proportions and exceptional articulation with polycap-free construction.

Experience the Providence Gundam's devastating all-range attack capabilities with its signature DRAGOON System. All three large and eight small DRAGOON pods are fully detachable from the backpack and skirt armor, and can be showcased in their deployed firing formations using the five included clear struts. The MA-MV05A Composite Armed Shield System, mounted on the left arm, features integrated beam guns and can deploy a large beam saber with an included vibrant beam effect part. Additional gimmicks, such as ankle extensions and a movable cockpit hatch that reveals a seated 1/100 scale Rau Le Creuset pilot figure, enhance the realism and building enjoyment.

This Master Grade kit is an intermediate to advanced build, offering rich details consistent with the MG SEED series and requiring no glue for assembly.

Included Equipment and Accessories:

- ZGMF-X13A Providence Gundam main body

- MA-M221 Judicium Beam Rifle x1

- MA-MV05A Composite Armed Shield System x1

- Large DRAGOON pods x3

- Small DRAGOON pods x8

- DRAGOON launch recreation clear struts x5

- Beam saber effect part x1

- Interchangeable hands (clenched, open, gun-wielding, open-hole clenched)

- 1/100 scale Rau Le Creuset pilot figure (seated)

- Display stand x1

- Dry transfer decal sheet x1

- Tetron sticker sheet x1

- Foil sticker sheet x1

- Instruction manual

Specifications:

- Scale: 1/100

- Assembled Height: Approximately 17.78 cm (7 inches)

- Material: PS (Polystyrene), TPE (Thermoplastic Elastomer)

4573102631510.short: The Master Grade 1/100 ZZ Gundam Ver.Ka is a highly detailed, transformable model kit featuring improved joints, dynamic posing, and a special finish. It includes multiple weapons, interchangeable parts, and no-glue assembly.
4573102631510.desc:
Experience the iconic Mobile Suit ZZ Gundam like never before with the Master Grade 1/100 ZZ Gundam Ver.Ka from BANDAI HOBBY. This highly anticipated model kit brings Hajime Katoki's renowned design sensibilities to the powerful ZZ Gundam, featuring elongated proportions inspired by the Enhanced ZZ and Full Armor ZZ variants seen in the latter half of the anime series.

This Master Grade Ver.Ka kit is engineered for both impressive display and complex transformation. It is fully transformable into the formidable G-Fortress, combining the Core Base, Core Top, and Core Fighter components with precision. Mechanical detailing throughout the shoulders, knees, and waist incorporates improved joints and sliding mechanisms, allowing for dynamic posing and faithful reproduction of its intricate deformations. The shoulder joints boast multiple movable axes, while the knee joints can achieve deep bending. An innovative 3-axis structure in the lumbar region enables twisting and bending forward, all while maintaining its transformation capabilities. Certain parts are treated with a special "extra finish" to enhance the model's profound aesthetic, and lining parts feature high detail even in transformed states.

This snap-fit kit requires no glue for assembly, making it an accessible yet rewarding build for enthusiasts.

Included in the box:

- Pieces to build the MG 1/100 ZZ Gundam Ver.Ka

- Double Beam Rifle x1

- Hyper Beam Saber x2

- Interchangeable hands (grip hand, saber handle, transforming hands, weapon handle)

- Core Fighters x2 (one for transformation, one spare)

- Multi-tube missile launchers

- Waterslide Decal x1

- Foil Seal x1

- Instruction Manual x1

- 1/100 scale pilot figure (Judo Ashta)

Specifications:

- Scale: 1/100

- Material: PS, PE, PVC

- Series: Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ

4573102642585.short: Celebrate the 40th anniversary of Macross with this transformable YF-19 model kit featuring a simplified three-stage transformation system, enhanced articulation, and detailed mode-specific parts for Battroid, Gerwalk, and Fighter forms.
4573102642585.desc:
Experience the iconic YF-19 from the Macross series like never before with this High Grade 1/100 scale model kit from BANDAI HOBBY. Commemorating the 40th anniversary of the Macross anime, this kit introduces a new standard for transformable models, capturing the essence of the advanced variable fighter.

This YF-19 features the innovative "Replacement Three-Stage Transformation (Shortcut Change)" system, meticulously re-evaluating deformation, form, and movability. By incorporating strategic parts replacement, the transformation sequence is simplified, allowing for effortless conversion between its distinct Battroid, Gerwalk, and Fighter modes. This new system ensures that the intricate forms and setting images of each mode are pursued and realized in three dimensions, free from the constraints often found in fully transforming mechanisms.

Enjoy an enhanced range of articulation, achieved by eliminating complex internal structures to provide new levels of poseability and movement. The canopy part utilizes "polarization molding," creating captivating color variations that shift with the angle and intensity of light.

Included in the box:

- Gun pod x 1

- Shield x 1

- Effect parts for Pinpoint Barrier Punch x 1

- Landing gear x 1 set

- Parts for Fighter form reproduction x 1 set

- Parts for Gerwalk form reproduction x 1 set

- Joint parts x 1 set

- Hand parts x 1 set

- Name stickers x 2

Specifications:

- Scale: 1/100

- Material: Plastic

- Approximate Height (Battroid mode): 12 inches (30.48 cm)

4573102654298.short: Forbidden Gundam from Bandai Hobby is a highly detailed 1/100 scale model featuring dynamic posing, transformation capabilities, and realistic mechanical elements like the Nidhoggr heavy scythe and flexible armor. It captures the aggressive style of the Mobile Suit Gundam SEED series with intricate
4573102654298.desc:
Forbidden Gundam completes the Earth Alliance trio in the Full Mechanics 1/100 lineup with a stunning modern arrangement and high-density mechanical detail. This kit captures the aggressive aesthetic of the Mobile Suit Gundam SEED series while maintaining an assembly process that balances complexity with ease of build.

The mechanical design is emphasized through intricate molding found even in the interior of the exhaust ports and behind the armor plates. The signature Nidhoggr heavy scythe features two distinct surface finishes on its blade to provide a realistic contrast in textures. For added realism, the energy cable connecting the scythe to the backpack is reproduced using a flexible varnish tube.

Dynamic posing and transformation are central to this model. The Geschmeidig Panzer energy deflection armor is mounted on a flexible arm and includes a deployable shield. The backpack features multiple axes of movement, allowing for precise angle adjustments. When shifting into the high-speed assault form, the head sinks into the torso as the backpack moves forward, achieving the transformation with minimal motion and zero interference.

Combat features include the 88mm Eckzahn railguns which can be fully extended from the backpack. The magnetic field generators used to curve the Fresberg beam trajectory are also capable of rotation, allowing for the recreation of iconic action scenes from the anime. The collar armor even moves in conjunction with the rotation of the chest intake block to maintain a natural silhouette during posing.

Included items:

- Forbidden Gundam

- Nidhoggr Heavy Scythe

- Action base joint

- Varnish tube

- Marking seals

- Instruction manual

Specifications:

- Scale: 1/100

- Material: PS plastic

- Series: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED

- Manufacturer: Bandai Hobby

It includes weapons, a figurine, and requires no glue or paint.
4573102662897.desc:
Experience the ZGMF-56E2/α Force Impulse Gundam Spec II, now available as a highly detailed Real Grade model kit from BANDAI HOBBY. This 1/144 scale kit captures the mobile suit as it appears in the Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom animated film, bringing its dynamic design and advanced capabilities to your collection.

This RG kit meticulously recreates the intricate mechanism allowing the Core Splendor, Chest Flyer, Leg Flyer, and Force Silhouette to combine and form the complete MS Mode. An Advanced MS Joint, featuring insert molding on the Core Splendor and body, provides exceptional articulation and stability. The internal frame and body frame can be detached from the runner in an assembled state, offering precise details and advanced deformation and movement gimmicks right out of the box.

Enjoy superior color reproduction thanks to advanced parts division, accurately representing even the most minute color separations of adjacent armor pieces. The Force Silhouette, designed with a unique RG verification as an "Air Craft," features detailed gimmicks and textures, including wings that can fold backward. The forearms twist on a separate axis from the elbows, and shoulder armors rotate independently to minimize parts interference, ensuring a wide range of dynamic posing options. Waist parts move by block, further enhancing articulation, and the knee armor moves in conjunction with the legs.

Specifications:

- Scale: 1/144

- Materials: PS, PP, ABS

- Release Date: February 2024

- Age Range: 15+ years

- No glue or paint required for assembly

Included:

- High-energy Beam Rifle x 1

- Mobile Shield x 1

- Vajra Beam Sabers x 2

- Folding Razor Anti-armor Knives x 2

- Silhouette Flyer x 1

- Core Splendor parts set x 1

- Hand parts x 1 set (includes grip, flat, and weapon-holding hands)

- Joint parts x 1

- Realistic decals x 1 (newly designed)

- 1/144 Shinn Asuka figurine x 1

This High Grade model kit captures the immense scale and intricate details of the formidable Destroy Gundam, standing at an impressive approximate height of 390mm (15.34 inches).

Experience the full versatility of this mechanical marvel with its complete transformation capability into Mobile Armor (MA) form, faithfully replicating its in-series appearance. The large scale allows for exceptionally detailed molding throughout the kit, showcasing the Destroy Gundam's complex design.

Stability is paramount for such a massive model, and the kit incorporates robust lock mechanisms in key areas including the head, arms, legs, and back, ensuring secure posing in both Mobile Suit and Mobile Armor configurations. Each of the Destroy Gundam's five fingers is individually articulated at every joint, providing a wide range of expressive hand poses for dynamic displays. Elevate your presentation with the included large beam effect part, measuring approximately 260mm in length and featuring polarized light molding that shifts color depending on the viewing angle and light source. The arms are also designed to connect to a separately sold action base, allowing for even more dramatic aerial poses.

Included:

- Instruction manual

4573102663061.desc:
Unleash the striking presence of Lunamaria Hawke's custom mobile suit with the HG 1/144 GELGOOG Menace. Directly from the cinematic adventure of "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM", this High Grade kit from BANDAI HOBBY captures the distinctive red and black color scheme and aggressive styling of Lunamaria's personal machine.

This model kit incorporates the innovative SEED Action System, an internal structure specifically engineered to allow for dynamic and iconic action poses seen throughout the "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED" series. Experience exceptional articulation, including a natural standing knee pose despite the suit's voluminous design, ensuring a wide range of posing possibilities for your display.

The GELGOOG Menace features movable wings, allowing the linear cannon and missiles to be positioned forward for attack stances. Its enhanced beam rifle is perfect for recreating long-range sniping actions, while the close-quarters Beam Naginata includes a grip for storage and can be conveniently mounted on the waist when not in use. A Beam Shield, utilizing polarized molding, is also included, capable of recreating both its stored and deployed states through simple parts rearrangement.

This snap-fit kit is designed for a satisfying build experience right out of the box, with detailed color-coding of parts by molding colors, minimizing the need for additional paint. It is also compatible with other Wizard Packs from the High Grade Gundam SEED or 1/144 Gundam SEED Destiny Collection Series lines, offering customization potential.

Specifications:

- Height: Approximately 13 cm when assembled

- Material: PS (Polystyrene)

- Series: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM

4573102663078.short: The HG 1/144 GYAN Strom (AGNES GIEBENRATH CUSTOM) is a detailed model kit of Agnes Giebenrath's mobile suit from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom, featuring dynamic posing with the SEED Action System, customizable armaments, and faithful reproduction of key design elements.
4573102663078.desc:
Step into the cockpit with the HG 1/144 GYAN Strom (AGNES GIEBENRATH CUSTOM), a highly anticipated High Grade model kit from the Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom film. This meticulously detailed kit brings Agnes Giebenrath's personalized mobile suit to life, a successor to the ZGMF-X2000 Gouf Ignited, now operated by the world peace monitoring organization 'COMPASS'. Its design thoughtfully incorporates elements that pay homage to the classic Gyan.

Experience dynamic posing thanks to the integrated "SEED Action System," an internal structure specifically engineered to replicate iconic action sequences from the Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom series. Enhanced arm articulation is achieved through sliding mechanisms in the shoulder armor connectors, allowing for a wider range of movement. The kit faithfully reproduces characteristic details, including the lines below the head camera and the distinctive pink paint on the outer rim of the shield, utilizing BANDAI's advanced color separation and part division technology.

Customize your display with versatile armaments and features. The distinctive beam axe can be securely mounted to the hip by swapping in the included storage grip. Movable wings allow you to position the missile launchers forward, while the chest armor can unfold, enabling the recreation of the Gatling gun's extended state by inserting the dedicated parts. A heat rod can be equipped on the right arm, and the shield comes with effect parts to add an extra layer of dynamism to your poses. The backpack is also designed for versatility, with swappable components for atmospheric or space-use specifications.

Included in the box:

- Gyan Strom mobile suit (parts to build)

- Beam Axe x1 set

- Heat Rod x1

- Beam Saber x1

- Beam Rifle x1

- Beam Gatlings x2

- Shield x1

- Effect parts x1 set

- Joint parts x1

- Hand parts x1 set

- Stickers x1

- Instruction manual

4573102663849.desc:
The HG 1/144 Mighty Strike Freedom Gundam joins the High Grade series, bringing the iconic Mobile Suit from "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM" to life. This model kit is engineered for dynamic posing and faithful recreation of its on-screen appearance.

Experience exceptional articulation thanks to the "SEED Action System," an internal structure specifically designed to reproduce the impressive action poses seen in the "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM" series. The leg-to-groin joints feature mechanisms allowing individual upward and downward swinging, enabling extended toe poses and perfectly aligned leg stances. The kit's golden sections utilize realistic metallic gloss injection, providing an enhanced metallic luster right out of the box. The gold plastic from the C runner is also UV reactive, offering a unique visual effect under ultraviolet light.

The Mighty Strike Freedom's distinctive wings move individually and boast a wide range of articulation. The white wings incorporate eight sliding sections that can be deployed to recreate their unfolded state. The Proud Defender backpack can be detached and displayed independently, adding versatility to your display options. Recreate the revealed state of the forehead cannon by swapping parts, and deploy the waist-mounted railguns to pose the Gundam in a simultaneous firing stance. The included "Futsunomitama" physical blade features two distinct surface finishes on its blade parts, adding to its realistic detail.

Included in the box:

- Mighty Strike Freedom Gundam model kit

- Sword (Futsunomitama) x1

- Beam Rifles x2

- Beam Sabers x2

- Combined Saber grip x1

- Beam Shield x1

- Stickers x1

4573102671455.cats: Plastic Model Kits Original Series Model Kits
4573102671455.short: The PLANNOSAURUS Tyrannosaurus model kit lets you build a detailed, poseable dinosaur from skeleton to skin, with customizable painting and optional feathered parts for an educational, hands-on experience.
4573102671455.desc:
Discover the prehistoric world with the PLANNOSAURUS Tyrannosaurus Painting Ver. model kit, offering an immersive journey into dinosaur anatomy and reconstruction. This unique plastic model allows enthusiasts to build the mighty Tyrannosaurus from its skeletal structure to its outer skin, providing an educational and engaging experience.

A standout feature is the innovative material, a blend of plastic and paper powder, specifically designed to be highly receptive to paint. This allows for extensive customization, inviting you to bring your personal vision of the Tyrannosaurus to life using acrylic gouache or other household paints.

The kit features a "Skeletal Build" phase, where you construct the internal bone structure, followed by the "Dinosaur Build," which involves attaching the outer skin parts over the skeleton. This two-phase assembly provides a deeper understanding of dinosaur anatomy not typically seen in textbooks or standard models.

Assembly is straightforward and user-friendly, requiring no nippers, adhesives, or other specialized tools. The model also includes selectable parts, allowing you to reproduce the Tyrannosaurus with feathers, based on the latest paleontological theories.

Once assembled, the highly detailed model showcases the intricate structure of the Tyrannosaurus's powerful legs, characteristic teeth, and sharp claws. Its mouth can open and close, and the forelimbs, hind limbs, neck, and tail are all articulated, enabling a wide range of dynamic posing options for display.

Included in the box:

- Outer skin parts (feathers) x1 set

- Display base x1

4573102671714.short: The Lightning Buster Gundam from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM is a 1/144 scale High Grade model kit featuring detailed articulation, the SEED Action System, and poseable large cannons. It includes beam gun parts, stickers, and is compatible with the METEOR unit.
4573102671714.desc:
The Lightning Buster Gundam, piloted by Dearka Elthman from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM, joins the High Grade lineup as an impressive 1/144 scale model kit. This rendition captures the formidable mobile suit with exceptional detail and articulation, perfect for recreating iconic scenes or dynamic custom poses.

At its core, this kit incorporates the innovative SEED Action System, an internal structure specifically designed to reproduce the striking action poses seen in the Mobile Suit Gundam SEED series. The left and right connectors on the groin joint feature individual articulation, allowing for a wide range of bold and expressive stances.

The Lightning Buster Gundam's powerful arsenal is faithfully recreated. The Beam Cannon on the waist can be displayed in its deployed state using exchangeable barrel parts. Its signature large cannons are fully deployable from their folded configuration, with movable arm parts enabling them to be positioned at various angles, including over the legs and waist. For added detail, the hatches on the back open to reveal the missiles stored within. The entire body features detailed color coding, meticulously reproduced through precise parts division. This kit is also designed for compatibility with the separately sold METEOR unit, offering expanded display possibilities.

Included in the box:

- Waist beam gun parts × 2

- Stickers × 1

Specifications:

- Scale: 1/144

- Series: High Grade Cosmic Era (HGCE) from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM

- Material: Plastic

The internal frame design of this Z’GOK is modeled after the "INFINITE JUSTICE GUNDAM Type II," offering a unique detail for enthusiasts and allowing for some parts from the separately sold HG 1/144 INFINITE JUSTICE GUNDAM Type II to be combined with it.

Included in the kit:

- Backpack x 1

- Heat Claws x 2

- Damaged Armor x 1

- Beam effects x 4

- Stickers x 1

Specifications:

- Scale: 1/144

- Material: PS (Plastic)

4580590125544.short: This Nendoroid captures Jack Nicholson's Joker from the 1989 Batman film, featuring two face plates and optional parts for display. It blends menace with chibi charm in a 100mm articulated figure.

4580590125629.short: Katsuki Bakugo from My Hero Academia is featured in the Nendoroid Swacchao! line, posed adorably in a seated position. This articulated figure includes a stand and is perfect for collectors looking to add charm to their display.

4580590125704.short: A large-scale figma of the Doom Slayer from DOOM Eternal features posable joints and comes with multiple weapons and display parts for dynamic poses.
4580590125704.desc: Rip and tear, until it is done. From the popular game "DOOM Eternal" comes a figma of the main character, the Doom Slayer! The Doom Slayer has been faithfully recreated in large size. Using the smooth yet posable joints of figma, you can create a variety of poses from the series. A flexible plastic is used for important areas, allowing proportions to be kept without compromising posability. The Chainsaw, Super Shotgun, Crucible Blade and BFG-9000 are all included as optional parts. Parts are included to display the Equipment Launcher and DOOM Blade in both retracted and deployed forms. An articulated figma stand is included to display the figma in a variety of poses.

4580590127159.short: A posable figma of Yuji Itadori from Jujutsu Kaisen featuring multiple facial expressions, curse effects, and a Sukuna-themed hand for dynamic combat displays.
4580590127159.desc: "I'm not gonna regret the way I live!" From the anime series "Jujutsu Kaisen" comes a figma of the main character Yuji Itadori! · Using the smooth yet posable joints of figma, you can create a variety of action-packed poses from the game. · A flexible plastic is used for important areas, allowing proportions to be kept without compromising posability. · He comes with four face plates including a smiling face, an angry face, a shouting face and a Ryomen Sukuna face. · Curse effect parts and a Black Flash effect part are included to recreate combat scenes. · A hand part with the mouth of Ryomen Sukuna on it is also included. · An articulated figma stand is included to display the figma in a variety of poses.

4580590128156.short: Nendoroid Papyrus from Undertale features multiple face plates, swappable eyebrows, and optional parts like spaghetti and a blue bone. Collect him with Sans (sold separately).
4580590128156.desc: THEN, I, THE GREAT PAPYRUS... WILL GET ALL THE THINGS I UTTERLY DESERVE! From the popular 2D RPG game Undertale comes a Nendoroid of Papyrus! This cool dude has been faithfully created in Nendoroid form, with 3 different face plates and swappable eyebrow parts to express a wide range of emotion. Optional parts include a plate of spaghetti and the blue bone used in his fabled "blue attack". Be sure to add Nendoroid Papyrus and his lazy brother Sans (sold separately) to your collection!

4580590128408.short: A Nendoroid of Panda from Jujutsu Kaisen featuring multiple face plates, optional accessories, and a baby figure for poseable display.
4580590128408.desc: "I panda. I no understand human speech." From the anime series "Jujutsu Kaisen" comes a Nendoroid of Panda! He comes with a standard face plate and an angry face plate! Optional parts include his armband, a "Panda" sign, a balloon as well as a miniature figure of Panda from when he was a baby! He also comes with a set of arm parts wearing his gloves for combat scenes! Enjoy creating all kinds of poses an situations, and be sure to display him with your other Nendoroids from "Jujutsu Kaisen"! Be sure to add him to your collection!

4580590128521.short: A posable figma of Megumi Fushiguro from Jujutsu Kaisen, featuring multiple faces and optional parts for dynamic display.
4580590128521.desc: "I save people unequally." From the anime series "Jujutsu Kaisen" comes a figma of Megumi Fushiguro! · Using the smooth yet posable joints of figma, you can create a variety of poses from the series. · A flexible plastic is used for important areas, allowing proportions to be kept without compromising posability. · He comes with three face plates including a standard face, a combat face and a "Chimera Shadow Garden" face. · Optional parts include three different types of hand parts to display him making shadow puppets, his Divine Dog and a shadow illustration sheet. · An articulated figma stand is included to display the figma in a variety of poses.

4580590128583.short: The Nendoroid Batman from The Batman features multiple face plates, optional parts like the Riddler's letter and Batmobile effect, and an articulated stand for dynamic poses. Designed by Shichibee for Good Smile Company.

4580590161948.desc: The first-ever plastic model of Ikaruga! From "Knight's & Magic" comes a rerelease of the plastic model kit of Ernesti Echavalier's mecha "Ikaruga"! The model has been faithfully recreated based on the design from the anime. The model is fully articulated, even including the four arms' Rough Fists on Ikaruga's back area. 4580590163027.short: A MODEROID plastic model of Daioja from ROBOT KING DAIOJA, featuring interchangeable parts to recreate the Cross Triangle combination. Includes weapons, multiple hand parts, and pre-painted components for easy assembly.
4580590163027.desc: See with your own eyes! Cross Triangle! From the anime series "ROBOT KING DAIOJA" comes a MODEROID plastic model of Daioja! The combination of Ace Redder, Aoider and Cobalter can be easily recreated in figure form with the use of interchangeable parts! The crest of the Tokugar family of the Edon nation that appears on the chest of the mecha when in combined form can also be captured in plastic model form with a special transformation feature. The model stands at 180mm in height to the top of the head in combined form. Various interchangeable hand parts are included. Each of the three individual mecha can be independently posed and also come with their own weapons. The mecha can be combined directly in Cross Triangle form, or it can be created with a look closer to its appearance in the anime series with the use of special parts. The Thunderbolt Sword, Daioja Javelin and Daioja Shield are included, and special chest parts to use when displaying the mecha with the shield are included as well. The grip of the Thunderbolt Sword can be attached to the Daioja Shield, allowing you to recreate the sequence in which the Thunderbolt Sword appears. The various parts of the mecha have been separated into different colored runners and pre-painted parts, making it easy to recreate the mecha from the series with a simple assembly.

4580590164673.desc: Energy Bomb! 3 combinable mecha are included each with 2 modes. Presenting a pre-colored plastic model of Gambaruger! From "Energy Bomb Gambaruger" comes a rerelease of the plastic model of Gambaruger! The three mecha Go Tiger, Mach Eagle and King Elephant can be recreated in both Animal Mode and Fighter Mode, and can also be combined to create Gambaruger. The model is made from ABS, PS, and POM plastic. The kit includes runners separated into 7 colors as well as pre-painted parts.

4580590168169.desc: From the beloved franchise "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles" comes a chibi-style soft vinyl figure of Krang! From the beloved franchise "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles" comes a chibi-style soft vinyl figure of Krang! The figure stands at an impressive 210mm in height. 4580590169142.cats: Plastic Model Kits Mech Model Kits
4580590169142.short: The MODEROID TechnoBoyger is a plastic model kit from Thunderbirds 2086, featuring pre-painted parts and stickers for easy assembly of TB-1, TB-2, and TB-3. A display stand is included.
4580590169142.desc: Save the earth! MODEROID TechnoBoyger launching now! From the anime series “Thunderbirds 2086” comes the first-ever plastic model of the TechnoBoyger! Model is approximately 280mm in length when combined. Create the combination of TB-1, TB-2 and TB-3. The various parts of the ships have been separated into different colored runners, pre-painted parts and stickers, making it easy to recreate the ships with a simple assembly. A dedicated display stand is included.

4580590170360.short: A Nendoroid of SpongeBob SquarePants includes multiple face plates, eye sets, and optional parts like Gary the Snail and a Krabby Patty for varied display options.
4580590170360.desc:
Presenting a Nendoroid of SpongeBob SquarePants!

From "SpongeBob SquarePants" comes a Nendoroid of SpongeBob SquarePants himself! He comes complete with two face plates as well as three different sets of eyes allowing for various different facial expressions. Optional parts include Gary the Snail, a Krabby Patty, a Krusty Krab staff hat and a spatula allowing for all sorts of display options. Even as a Nendoroid SpongeBob is energetic and ready for some fun, so be sure to add him to your collection!

4580590170407.short: A rerelease of the Nendoroid of Dabi from My Hero Academia includes three expressions, flame effect parts, and a "FOOOOSH" text plate for dynamic displays.
4580590170407.desc: "That's sad... Shoto... Todoroki..." From the popular anime series "My Hero Academia" comes a rerelease of the Nendoroid of Dabi, member of the League of Villains! He comes with three face plates including a standard expression, a condescending laughing expression and a crazed expression! Three kinds of flame effect parts for recreating Dabi's unidentified Quirk are included along with a "FOOOOSH" text plate for recreating action scenes. Be sure to add him to your collection!

4580590170414.short: A Nendoroid action figure of Shoto Todoroki from My Hero Academia, featuring multiple expressions, hero costume details, and effect parts to showcase his Half-Cold Half-Hot Quirk.
4580590170414.desc: "It's not your fault. We're just playing on different levels." From the popular anime series "My Hero Academia" comes a rerelease of the Nendoroid action figure of one of the main character Deku's rivals, Shoto Todoroki! He comes with three interchangeable face plates including his calm and composed standard expression, his combat expression for when he's fighting with all he's got and his smiling expression from when he began to accept the left side of his Quirk. His hero costume has been faithfully recreated in Nendoroid size. He comes with fire and ice effect parts along with ice floor effect parts to recreate his 'Half-Cold Half-Hot' Quirk. A "CRAASH" text plate is also included to create action-filled poses!

4580590170421.short: A re-released Nendoroid of Tomura Shigaraki from My Hero Academia, featuring removable hand parts, two face plates, and special pieces for his Decay Quirk, allowing fans to recreate various scenes.
4580590170421.desc: "After all this waiting, the heroic piece of trash shows up." From the popular anime series "My Hero Academia" comes a rerelease of the Nendoroid of Tomura Shigaraki, the leader of the League of Villains. The numerous hand parts that cover his body are all removable. He comes with two face plates including his scornful standard expression and a spine-chilling crazed expression. Special hand parts to display him using his 'Decay' Quirk are included along with interchangeable front hair parts, allowing you recreate all kinds of scenes and situations. Be sure to add him to your collection, and enjoy recreating your favorite scenes from "My Hero Academia"!

4580590170735.short: This HELLO! GOOD SMILE Yami Yugi figure from Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters features a cute chibi design with a playful stance and vibrant colors. It includes a movable neck joint and a stand for display.

4580590170742.short: The HELLO! GOOD SMILE Dark Magician Girl is a charming chibi-style collectible from Yu-Gi-Oh!, featuring a cute design, slight neck articulation, and a display stand. Created under the direction of Shigeto Koyama, it's part of Good Smile Company's playful and expressive figure series.
4580590170742.desc: HELLO! GOOD SMILE Dark Magician Girl

4580590172357.short: The Nendoroid of Kobeni Higashiyama from Chainsaw Man features three interchangeable faces and optional weapon parts, allowing fans to display her in various expressive poses.

4580590173361.short: A Nendoroid of Gon Freecss from HUNTER x HUNTER, featuring multiple expressions and special hair parts to recreate his Chimera Ants Arc transformation. The tallest Nendoroid to date, it pairs well with the upcoming Killua Zoldyck figure.
4580590173361.desc: "I'm really glad I met you, Killua!" From the popular anime series "HUNTER x HUNTER" comes a Nendoroid of the protagonist Gon Freecss! He comes with three face plates including his standard expression, his innocent smiling expression and his awakened expression from the Chimera Ants Arc. Special hair parts are also included to be displayed with the awakened expression to recreate his famous transformation appearance. Measured with the special hair parts, he is the tallest figure in Nendoroid history thus far! Have fun recreating the memorable awakening scene. Nendoroid Killua Zoldyck (sold separately) is also scheduled to be available for preorder soon. Display them together to recreate their high-five and peace sign poses! Look out for more "HUNTER x HUNTER" Nendoroids soon, and be sure to add them to your collection!

4580590173378.short: A Nendoroid of Killua Zoldyck from HUNTER x HUNTER, featuring multiple expressions and a yo-yo for combat scenes. Display with Gon Freecss (sold separately) to recreate iconic poses.
4580590173378.desc: "I'm pretty strong, sure you want to do this?" From the popular anime series "HUNTER x HUNTER" comes a Nendoroid of the protagonist Gon Freecss good friend Killua Zoldyck! He comes with his childlike smiling expression, his mischievous cat face expression and a composed expression for when he is in assassin mode. One of his yo-yos is included to recreate combat scenes! Display with Nendoroid Gon Freecss (sold separately) to recreate their high-five and peace sign poses! Be sure to add him to your collection, along with the rest of the "HUNTER x HUNTER" series Nendoroids!

4580590173590.short: The Nendoroid Sonic the Hedgehog is a collectible figure featuring multiple expressions, poseable parts for his running stance, and game-themed extras like a ring, chaos emerald, and item box.
4580590173590.desc:
The world's fastest hedgehog is back once again!

Originally released as a part of the Sonic series' 20th anniversary, the popular Nendoroid Sonic the Hedgehog is now set to be rereleased again! 4580828665248.desc:
Nendoroid Naruto! Believe it!!

From the popular anime series "Naruto Shippuden" comes a rerelease of the Nendoroid of the main character, Naruto Uzumaki! Nendoroid designs are known to make the characters look younger than normal, but the confident expression of the grown-up Naruto has been faithfully captured in cute Nendoroid size!

Effect parts for both the Rasengan and Rasenshuriken are included to pose Naruto making use of two of his most memorable ninjutsu techniques, and both parts make use of a translucent material which make for a cute yet impressive appearance! Naruto can be posed holding the rasenshuriken as well as throwing it by making use of the special stand which allows it to be displayed floating high up in the air!

The hand seals used for his techniques have been adorably shrunk down into Nendoroid size, and the wrist parts are interchangeable which means you can make use of other hand parts to recreate different hand seals! In addition, a special illustrated sheet of the tailed beast 'Kurama' is included to display Naruto interacting with the powerful Nine-Tails!

From the popular anime series "Naruto Shippuden" comes a rerelease of the Nendoroid of Sasuke Uchiha! Sasuke's cool and composed appearance from the Shippuden series has been faithfully converted into Nendoroid size and he comes complete with three face plates including his standard expression, a Sharingan expression as well as a Mangekyou Sharingan expression!

Nendoroid Sasuke also comes with a selection of optional parts including his 'Chidori' ninjutsu parts to contrast with Naruto's Rasengan. 4580828670938.desc:
Ladies and gentlemen, with great pleasure, I give you...

MODEROID RoboCop 2!

From the movie "RoboCop 2" comes a plastic model of RoboCop 2 (Cain)! The plastic model kit stands at an impressive 22cm in height, with its unique proportions and mechanical parts captured in stunning detail. The plastic model also comes equipped with various features for recreating scenes from the movie.

Each joint, including its two secondary arms, are completely articulated. The head monitor can be displayed in its open state with the use of interchangeable parts. 3 types of monitor graphic stickers are included. The abdomen hatch can be displayed open or closed with the use of interchangeable parts. Lead wires have been used to create the arm cables, while flexible tubing has been used to create the abdomen cables. Pre-assembled click joints are utilized in the lower body, allowing for stable posing in spite of the model's larger size.

Water-slide decals are included as well. The model is designed in the same scale as HAGANE WORKS RoboCop and MODEROID ED-209 (sold separately), so be sure to display them together!

4582362385262.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4582362385262.short: This plastic model kit replicates the iconic arcade game "Darius" aircraft in 1/144 scale, featuring easy assembly with snap-fit joints and a detailed, color-coded finish. Includes a dedicated display base.
4582362385262.desc: "Darius" is a side-scrolling shooter game that appeared as an arcade game in 1986. The large chassis with three connected screens and the sound system with bass speakers built into the bench seat became a hot topic at the time. The legendary side-scrolling shooter ""Silver Hawk"" has been three-dimensionalized in a plastic kit at 1/144. With the full cooperation of Taito, we faithfully reproduced the aircraft in the image illustration. By color coding by thorough division of parts, the finish is close to the image just by assembling. In addition to precise modeling, it is a shaft-click joint type kit that can be easily assembled even for plastic kit beginners. It also comes with a dedicated exhibition base.

It comes with a "booster unit" that appears in the game. [Variable wings for trajectory control] that extend outward from both sides of the booster are set around commercialization and can be deployed. Along with the renewal, the molding color of the main body color has been changed to a color that is closer to the aircraft color of the in-game movie. The materials have been reviewed to make it easier to assemble.

4582362385958.cats: Plastic Model Kits Scale Model Kits
4582362385958.short: This 1/100 scale R-9A Arrow-Head model kit from R-Type Final 3 Evolved features multi-colored molded parts, detailed cockpit and pilot, Force unit with new parts, Round Bit, and a flexible display base for various setups.
4582362385958.desc:
The legendary R-9A Arrow-Head returns to the front lines with this specialized 1/100 scale plastic model kit, specifically designed to match its appearance in R-Type Final 3 Evolved. Developed with the full cooperation of Granzella Co., Ltd., this kit faithfully reproduces the iconic spacecraft as seen on the game's official package art.

The model features a high level of part separation, with components molded in multiple colors to ensure a professional look straight out of the box without the absolute necessity for paint. For those looking to add extra authenticity, the kit includes a dedicated set of decals to capture every technical marking and detail of the original design.

Attention to detail extends to the interior, where the cockpit and pilot figure have been carefully sculpted to maintain the scale and immersion of the series. This version also introduces newly molded parts for the Force unit and includes the Round Bit, providing a complete tactical loadout for display.

The included display base is designed with versatility in mind, featuring separate supports for both the R-9A and the Force. This allows you to position the Force unit in front of or behind the ship, or even display the spacecraft entirely on its own to suit your collection's layout.

- 1/100 scale R-9A Arrow-Head model kit

- Force unit with newly molded side parts

- Round Bit accessory

- Detailed pilot figure and cockpit interior

- Multi-part display base for flexible posing

- Custom decal sheet

Specifications

- Scale: 1/100

- Total Length: Approximately 250mm

- Material: Plastic (PS)

- Series: R-Type Final 3 Evolved

- Manufacturer: PLUM PMOA
