4895250806917.short: The Transformers: Rise of the Beasts DLX Bumblebee figure features detailed design, LED lighting, interchangeable parts, and high articulation, capturing the movie’s upgraded bot and battle modes.
4895250806917.desc:
The next exciting installment in the "Transformers" film series, "Transformers: Rise of the Beasts," is in theaters this summer and the beloved Autobot Bumblebee makes his dazzling return to the cinema and to threezero’s DLX Collectible Figure Series with his all-new upgraded bot mode design! 

“Transformers: Rise of the Beasts” DLX Bumblebee faithfully reproducing the movie's design in every detail and appearance, carefully depicting Bumblebee's stylish new bot-mode. DLX Bumblebee’s eye components on the Battle Head feature interchangeable dual-color red and blue LED lights, and includes interchangeable dual-arm Ion Blasters equipped with LED light-up effects, perfectly capturing Bumblebee’s battle mode. The wheels on the body are made of soft rubber-like material with added weathering effects. The highly articulated DLX Bumblebee has cleverly designed joints, allowing for seamless and extensive range of motion throughout his entire body including the rear wings which can replicate their folded and unfolded positions. The action continues with threezero's renowned craftsmanship and weathered paint application fully replicating this heroic Autobot.

DLX Collectible Figures present intricate Transformers designs in a smaller scale with high-fidelity production value. With its unique die-cast metal frame design, DLX not only provides an advanced range of articulation, but also greatly enhances the weight and durability. Together with the detailed and weathered paint application of threezero, a remarkable resemblance is achieved in matching the characters as seen in the original media.

FEATURES 
• Officially Licensed by Hasbro and TakaraTomy
• Approximately 8 inches (~23.2cm) tall
• Approximately 60 points of articulation
• Detailed and weathered paint application
• Die-cast Metal frame design with advanced range of articulation 
• LED illuminated eyes, Ion Blaster, Battle Head Eyes 

ACCESSORIES
• One (1) pc of interchangeable Battle Head
• One (1) pair of Ion Blasters
• Four (3) pairs of interchangeable hands: one (1) pair of fists, one (1) pair of relaxed hands and one (1) pair of action hands
• One (1) DLX action stand

LED FEATURES*
• Eyes 
• Ion Blaster
• Battle Head Eyes

4895250807334.short: The Transformers: Rise of the Beasts DLX Optimus Prime figure features detailed design, 53 points of articulation, LED eyes, and multiple weapons and interchangeable hands for dynamic posing.
4895250807334.desc:
Transformers: Rise of the Beasts" brings us the seventh chapter in the Transformers film saga, taking place in the 90’s where Autobot Leader Optimus Prime unites with new allies in order to face their biggest enemy yet. “Transformers: Rise of the Beasts" DLX Optimus Prime continues the high-quality craftsmanship of the DLX series, introducing new elements and details, faithfully reproducing his updated design and arsenal from the film.

The “Transformers: Rise of the Beasts" DLX Optimus Prime stands approximately 11.2 inches tall, with 53 points of articulation, and contains an intricate alloy skeleton that provides a high-quality tactile feel with ample amounts of articulation. The joint design is carefully crafted with interlinking level of detail for a near seamless appearance. 

“Transformers: Rise of the Beasts” DLX Optimus Prime contains an impressive attention to detail. His eyes are equipped with LED light effects making the figure come to life. DLX Optimus Prime comes equipped with dual arm ion blasters, two Energon Swords, and an Energon Axe. There are three sets of interchangeable hands (fists, relaxed hands, and action hands), and when paired with the DLX action stand, he is capable of a large variety of iconic poses. 

This figure set also includes one Axe Holding Hand for Transformers: Rise of the Beasts DLX Bumblebee in order to recreate the memorable scene from the film when Bumblebee wields Optimus Prime’s axe.

FEATURES 
• Officially Licensed by Hasbro and TakaraTomy
• Approximately 11.2 inches (~28.5cm) tall

4895250809444.short: Dango is a 9-cm-tall articulated action figure from Kokone Link, featuring 49 joints, LED-lit eyes and forehead, and a switchable battle mode with poseable arm cannon and interchangeable hands. It includes multiple accessories and can be converted into a keychain.
4895250809444.desc:
The mysterious little robotic character “Dango” from the sci-fi illustrated novel "Kokone Link" has officially joined threezero's MDLX product line!

Dango is the birthday gift given to Orihashi Kokone by Orihashi Yota. The origin and identity of Dango remain uncertain. Despite being only 9 centimeters tall, it possesses formidable abilities and engages in battles with monsters to protect Kokone.

High articulation joints & incomparable tactile sensation

MDLX Dango features approximately 49 highly articulated joints, utilizing innovative die-cast zinc alloy combined with engineering plastic frame structure. This enables the action figure to maintain both high poseability and solid durability, while greatly enhancing the stiffness of joints and overall experience for the players.

Switching mode feature & linked eyelids

It can switch between normal mode and battle mode, recreating the settings from the story. It has stretching or interlinked mechanism in the head, neck, and thighs. After switching, not only does the height and appearance change, but the eyelids also automatically raise or lower to express different expressions. The arm armor can be opened, and the "arm cannon" extends out with a interlinked mechanism.

Innovative independently rotating illuminated eyeballs

With its innovative eyes design, in addition to the blue LED lighting function, they can be turned to different direction independently, creating various cute and lively expressions, perfectly matching different modes and scenarios. Apart from the eyes, the transparent portion on the forehead is also equipped with lighting function.

Top-tier painting craftsmanship & over 100 components

With threezero's exclusive top-tier painting craftsmanship and over 100 exquisitely sculpted components, the 9-cm-tall articulated collector-grade figure once again sets a new benchmark for model toys.

A wide range of accessories brings players’ unprecedented experience

The accessories include a pair of transparent blue beam swords and a pair of transparent yellow beam cannon effect parts. These can be installed in the cannon ports hidden under the forearm armor, allowing for both long-range and close-range attack poses. Additionally, it includes three pairs of interchangeable hands (fists, open hands, gripping hands), as well as a right hand in a V-sign and a right hand with thumb-up gesture, showcasing Dango's lively personality.

With the small hole at the back of MDLX Dango's head, Consumer can simply screw and assemble the keychain accessory and turn Dango to a Keychain, replicating the scene of the story where it hangs on Kokone backpack.

4934054006427.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054006427.short: The A-Class Maverick Hunter Zero from the Mega Man X series is now available as a detailed plastic model kit, featuring interchangeable parts, a lit Z-Saber with Milight compatibility, and multiple hand and facial expressions for dynamic poses.
4934054006427.desc:
The A-Class Maverick Hunter, Zero, arrives!

With over 35 million units in sales, the Mega Man series is a beloved video game franchise with fans of all generations throughout the world. 

Incredibly popular for their fast-paced action and deep storytelling, the games inspired a variety of spinoff games and media, including the Mega Man X series that became a core brand within the franchise.

From that series, Zero—the Maverick Hunter, dependable mentor, and friend to the protagonist X—is appearing for the first time as a plastic model kit after 25 years.

Thanks to the technology of CAD engineering, the character’s proportions, which are based on the character’s appearance in the game, are faithfully recreated while maintaining an impressive range of articulation that allows users to recreate a variety of scenes from the games!

Zero comes equipped with his signature Z-Saber in three different effects. By inserting a Milight 316 (lithium-ion battery with an LED attached) to the Z-Saber, the clear blade will light up!

Other included accessories such as the Buster, hand parts, three interchangeable facial expressions, and the Z-Saber make this model kit perfect for recreating many different situations from the games.

■ Model Specifications:

・The kit includes three interchangeable face parts.

・The Buster can be equipped to the model’s left or right arm.

・The kit includes four interchangeable hand parts.

・The hands holding the Z-Saber are interchangeable with the separately sold MEGA MAN X X.

・The Z-Saber can be mounted on the back.

・Three different Z-Saber effect parts are included.

・The blade of the Z-Saber is recreated with clear colored material.

・A Milight 316 (lithium-ion battery with an LED attached) can be inserted into the special Z- Saber hand part made for Milights to light up the blade of the Z-Saber.

*This part is only compatible with Milight 316 (lithium-ion battery with an LED attached).

・The model’s back features a 3mm connection point, making it compatible with separately sold bases from Kotobukiya’s M.S.G series, such as the NEW FLYING BASE and NEW FLYING BASE Plus.

・The kit is made of multi-colored plastic and contains pre-painted parts, making it easy for users of all levels to build Zero as he appears in the game.

・The packaging includes a specially drawn illustration by Mega Man X series character designer Keisuke Mizuno.

■ Included Items:

・Interchangeable Face Parts (Standard, Teeth Clenched, and Shouting)

・Interchangeable Buster

・Four Interchangeable Hand Parts (Closed, Open, Support, Weapon Holding)

・Three Z-Saber Effect Parts

・Special Z-Saber Holding Hand for Milight 316 (lithium-ion battery with an LED attached)

(This item is a reproduction.)

4934054006434.short: Kotobukiya's plastic model kit features the purple-hued "Zero Nightmare Version" from Mega Man X6, with newly sculpted hair, interchangeable parts, and compatibility with the original Zero model and M.S.G bases.
4934054006434.desc:
“WHERE IS ZERO? WHERE IS HE HIDING?”

The antagonist of the Nightmare Phenomena, fake Zero "Zero Nightmare Version" appears!

With over 35 million units in sales, the Mega Man series is a beloved video game franchise with fans of all generations throughout the world. 

Incredibly popular for their fast-paced action and deep storytelling, the games inspired a variety of spinoff games and media, including the Mega Man X series that became a core brand within the franchise.

From Mega Man X6, the antagonist of the Nightmare Phenomena, fake Zero "Zero Nightmare Version" joins Kotobukiya's plastic model lineup.

Contrasting the original color of Zero, the overall color scheme of Zero Nightmare Version is changed to purple based on the character's appearance in the game.

The new Nightmare Version of Zero's signature hair differs from the original with more movement incorporated in the sculpt.

The hair part in Zero's original color will also be included and it can be used with the separately sold Zero model kit to recreate many different situations from the games.

■ Model Specifications:

・The color scheme is changed to purple based on the Nightmare version’s appearance.

・The hair is newly sculpted and different from that of the separately sold Zero model kit.

・The kit includes the newly sculpted hair part in Zero's original color as a bonus part that can be used with the separately sold Zero.

・The kit includes three interchangeable face parts.

・The Buster can be equipped to the model’s left or right arm.

・The kit includes four interchangeable hand parts.

・The hands holding the Z-Saber are interchangeable with the separately sold MEGA MAN X X.

・The Z-Saber can be mounted on the back.

・Three different Z-Saber effect parts are included.

・The blade of the Z-Saber is recreated with clear colored material.

・A Milight 316 (lithium-ion battery with an LED attached) can be inserted into the special Z- Saber hand part made for Milights to light up the blade of the Z-Saber.

*This part is only compatible with Milight 316 (lithium-ion battery with an LED attached).

・The model’s back features a 3mm connection point, making it compatible with separately sold bases from Kotobukiya’s M.S.G series, such as the NEW FLYING BASE and NEW FLYING BASE Plus.

・The kit is made of multi-colored plastic and contains pre-painted parts, making it easy for users of all levels to build Zero as he appears in the game.

・The packaging includes a specially drawn illustration by Mega Man X series character designer Keisuke Mizuno.

■ Included Items:

・Interchangeable Face Parts (Standard, Teeth Clenched, and Shouting)

・Interchangeable Buster

・Four Interchangeable Hand Parts (Closed, Open, Support, Weapon Holding)

・Three Z-Saber Effect Parts

・Special Z-Saber Holding Hand for Milight 316 (lithium-ion battery with an LED attached)

4934054009596.cats: Plastic Model Kits Mech Model Kits
4934054009596.short: The Hexa Gear Governor Para-Pawn Sentinel receives major updates, including new PS material for better painting, redesigned molded parts, and improved articulation for easier posing.
4934054009596.desc:
Combat preparation complete. Start your engines.

Based on user requests, the Hexa Gear series’ Governor models are getting a massive upgrade! The second model to be updated is Governor Para-Pawn Sentinel.

■ Update 1:
The head, upper arm, thigh, abdomen, and crotch armor that were previously made of PVC are now made of PS, making them more suitable for painting and customization (the hand parts will still be made of PVC).

■ Update 2:
Along with the change of material, the part designs have also been reconfigured, and are made using a completely new mold. Although the design is unchanged, the head part is now made of three different colored pieces, while the rest of the design remains as is. The connector part on the HEXA G-R.A.M. piece for the back of the model has been change to a 3mm part.

■ Update 3:
The updated version of the model includes new articulation features that make the model easier to pose.
The hands can now be moved to the front and back.
The torso has been adjusted so that the ball joint does not pop out.
The boxes on the hips are now moveable, and the change of material prevents them from interfering with the movement of the model.

(This item is a reproduction.)

4934054019694.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054019694.short: Frame Arms Girl Magatsuki is a highly detailed, 80mm miniature model kit with 20 points of articulation, pre-printed face parts, and interchangeable components compatible with other Kotobukiya model lines.
4934054019694.desc: "The next product in line to join the Frame Arms Girl “hand scale” series is Frame Arms Girl Magatsuki! Based on the Frame Arms Magatsuki model designed by ToMo that has been stylized into bishoujo-style character art by E-ji Komatsu, this Frame Arms Girl is faithfully recreated in a new miniature scale that can fit in the palm of your hand! Model Specifications: ・The model kit includes two pre-printed face parts (Normal and Hurt). ・This miniature model uses data from Frame Arms Girl Magatsuki to maintain a high level of detail and accuracy even at the smaller scale! ・The sliding joint for the thigh’s connection shaft and the pop-out structure of the waist cloth parts allows for a wider range of movement for the legs. ・Including a newly-designed hand part for the sword, a total of five types of hand parts are included. • Despite its small stature of 80mm, the model boasts 20 points of articulation. • Multiple decals that include a variety of eye prints are included. • Two unprinted face parts for use with decals are included. What is the Hand Scale series? Thanks to advanced modeling technology, Kotobukiya is able to present a new line of miniature model kits with an unparalleled accuracy and articulation. These model kits are made of colored plastic and include pre-printed face parts, allowing you to create a detailed model with no painting required! The kits in this line include a variety of PVC hand parts and connection joints, making them compatible with parts from all of Kotobukiya’s existing model kit lines such as M.S.G, Frame Arms Girl, Hexa Gear and Frame Arms. The head, arm, and leg parts from all of the Hand Scale kits will be interchangeable, giving you even more customization options as the series grows."

4934054025077.cats: Plastic Model Kits Mech Model Kits
4934054025077.short: Agnirage is a red dragon-shaped third-generation Hexa Gear developed by SANAT to defend Crystal Reactors, featuring flight, a powerful beam weapon called Imperial Flame, and deployable drones for battlefield dominance.
4934054025077.desc:
Agnirage takes the form of a red dragon that serves as the protector of the Valiant Force’s Crystal Reactors.

The model is a third generation Hexa Gear developed independently by SANAT using Zoatex data copied from a stolen Voltrex unit.

While the construction of Agnirage’s base frame shares many similarities with Voltrex, the capabilities of the unit have been transfigured to an extent that far surpasses the original Voltrex unit. In addition to flight capabilities that surpass Blockbuster and the defense force field that protects the unit, Agnirage boasts a number of features that distinguish the unit’s prowess on the battlefield compared to the other third generation Hexa Gear.

One of Agnirage’s primary weapons is a long-range, chargeable beam known as the “Imperial Flame.” The powerful weapon is used by Agnirage to defend the Crystal Reactors from attackers by burning them to ash by harnessing the “flames of hell.”

Upon sensing enemy forces in its vicinity, Agnirage will immediately take off and fire the Imperial Flame at the enemy attackers from high in the sky. 

After unleashing total devastation on the enemy targets, which often lack defense from aerial attacks, Agnirage will deploy drones to take out the remaining enemies.

In order to accommodate the unit’s inferior armor defense in close-range land battles, Agnirage is equipped with a defense force field, allowing it to stave off attacks from the enemy’s foot soldiers. 

Agnirage units are typically used individually or in small groups in order to conquer enemy forces over a wide area with rapid precision, and are considered to be one of the biggest threats to the Liberty Alliance along with Para-Pawn Expander.

The exact timeline for the unit’s development is unknown. The unit’s existence was unknown until the initial attacks on the Crystal Reactors, and it is said that the unit already existed at the time of Demolition Brute’s appearance.

As a unit designed to defend some of the most crucial facilities for both armies, SANAT has dedicated its utmost effort to the development of Agnirage and loading the unit with the most advanced technologies. This highly advanced Hexa Gear which takes the form of a gigantic red dragon circles the sky around the Crystal Reactors, unleashing its flame on any enemies that dare to approach and reducing them to ashes.

Model Specifications:

■The Crime Punisher (Jaw) can be deployed to recreate the model when firing Imperial Flame.

■ A universal joint is used in the neck to allow flexible movements, vertically and horizontally.

■The drone stored in the thigh can be removed and used as a support machine.

■There are hidden claws on the shins that can be pulled out for use.

■The flaps on the solid wings are articulated. The model can take a landing pose by deploying the landing gear on the main thrusters and the fins on the main thruster move accordingly.

■A separately sold Governor can be mounted. Using the included support joints allow the model to be mounted more stably.  

■The hand grips are contractible and will not get in the way of posing.

■Parts such as the eye sensors, orange lines on the chest, and silver on the tail blade are pre-painted, so a model faithful to the completed design can be created just by assembling the model.

■A separately sold Flying Base Neo can be used to display the model freely, including aerial poses.

■A separately sold Mini Flying Base can be used to display the flight drones in the air.

Included Items:

■Drone x2

■Mini Flying Base Attachment for Drone x2

■Support Joint for Governor x1

■Archive Card x1

■Pipe Cable for Neck

(This item is a reproduction.)

4934054025107.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054025107.short: This kit features a detailed model of Metal Gear Sahelanthropus, designed under supervision by Yoji Shinkawa, with transformable forms, included weapons, and four posable figures.
4934054025107.desc:
From the long-awaited fifth installment in the Metal Gear series, METAL GEAR SOLID V: THE PHANTOM PAIN, comes the first-ever model of the armed bipedal weapon Metal Gear Sahelanthropus.

Under the supervision of Metal Gear Sahelanthropus’ designer, art director Yoji Shinkawa, the most faithful model of Metal Gear Sahelanthropus has been created.

The machine’s characteristic ability to transform from the REX form to the upright bipedal form has also been recreated.

This kit also includes archaea blades, archaea grenades, a dedicated shield, and a base.

A total of four figures are included: Venom Snake, Skull Face, Eli, and Third Child.

Third Child can also be posed as if he’s floating. 

The characteristic skull mark on the Metal Gear's head can be recreated with decals.

The package features official art by Yoji Shinkawa himself.

(This item is a reproduction)

4934054032211.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054032211.short: A collaboration between Frame Arms Girl and Hatsune Miku, this kit features a snow-themed Miku with new colors, multiple pre-painted faces, accessories, and compatibility with Frame Arms parts.
4934054032211.desc:
A collaboration project between Kotobukiya’s Frame Arms Girl and Hatsune Miku!

Based on designs by Humikane Shimada and Takayuki Yanase, Kotobukiya’s Frame Arms Girl and the beloved Hatsune Miku come together for a special collaboration! A cute snow-themed Hatsune Miku, Frame Music Girl Snow Miku Another Color Ver., arrives in all-new colors!

Model Specifications:

• This kit comes in new Snow Miku colors arranged by Humikane Shimada.
• Includes a scarf and mittens.
• Includes three face parts: singing, looking left, and looking right.
• The face parts are all pre-painted, allowing users to recreate a model faithful to the original art.
• Includes a mic and mic stand, speaker drones and translucent bases, as well as a base for Miku herself.
• In addition to the standard arm parts, arm parts without sleeves are included.
• Includes five pairs of PVC hands. The wrist joints are compatible with hand parts from existing Frame Arms Girl models.
• Decals for the eyes and other parts are included.
• The skirt is articulated allowing for wider range of movement for the legs.
• The model is equipped with 3mm joints at several points, including the back, waist, and thighs, making it compatible with parts from the M.S.G and Frame Arms series.

What is Frame Arms Girl?

Frame Arms Girl is a spin-off of Kotobukiya's original model kit series, Frame Arms, that creates a bishoujo-style character for each mecha. The kits come with multi-colored parts and face parts pre-printed with tampography, making them easy to assemble with no paint required. Equipped with the signature 3mm joints and PVC hands from Frame Arms, Frame Arms Girl models can be combined with a variety of parts from series such as M.S.G (Modeling Support Goods), Frame Arms, and more! The latest models' heads, arms, and legs in the series are fully compatible with each other, so users can create their very own unique Frame Arms Girl!

4934054035199.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054035199.short: Axl from Mega Man X7 is now available as a detailed plastic model kit, featuring interchangeable faces, hand parts, and wings, with easy assembly and game-accurate design.
4934054035199.desc:
Axl is finally here!

With over 36 million units in sales, the Mega Man series is a beloved video game franchise with fans of all generations throughout the world. 

Incredibly popular for their fast-paced action and deep storytelling, the games inspired a variety of spinoff games and media, including the Mega Man X series that became a core brand within the franchise.

Now, Axl, Mega Man X7's new generation Reploid, is being released as a plastic model kit for the first time in over 20 years since the release of the game!

Thanks to the technology of CAD engineering, the character’s proportions, which are based on the character’s appearance in the game, are faithfully recreated while maintaining an impressive range of articulation that allows users to recreate a variety of scenes from the games!

The kit includes two Axl Bullets, hand parts, and four different faces, allowing for the recreation of a variety of situations from Mega Man X7.

Model Specifications:

・Includes four interchangeable face parts.

・Includes two Axl Bullets.

・By switching out the parts, the wings on the back can be displayed in retracted mode.

・The model’s back features a 3mm connection point, making it compatible with separately sold bases from Kotobukiya’s M.S.G series, such as the NEW FLYING BASE and NEW FLYING BASE Plus.

・The kit is made of multi-colored plastic and contains pre-painted parts, making it easy for users of all levels to build Axl as he appears in the game.

・The packaging includes a specially drawn illustration by Mega Man X series character designer Keisuke Mizuno.

Included Items:

・Four Interchangeable Face Parts (Looking Forward/Default, Looking Right/Smirking, Looking Forward/Smiling, Looking Left/Shouting)

・Four Interchangeable Hand Parts (Closed, Open, Support, Weapon Holding)

・Interchangeable Wing Parts (Retracted)

・Axl Bullet ×2

4934054035212.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054035212.short: This Mega Man 11 plastic model kit features interchangeable faces, a poseable Buster, and effect parts for dynamic game-like poses, with easy assembly for all skill levels.
4934054035212.desc:
Over ten years have passed since the release of MEGA MAN in 2010, and now this plastic model kit is getting completely powered up with the all-new release of MEGA MAN -MEGA MAN 11 Ver.- / ROCKMAN -ROCKMAN 11 Ver.-!

This model fully adopts the techniques cultivated in the existing Mega Man X plastic model kit series such as the intricate part separation and the employment of CAD technology to achieve both proportion and articulation. Just building this model recreates Mega Man as if he stepped out of the game!

Furthermore, the inclusion of four interchangeable face parts full of personality, the Buster, impressive Charge Shot effect parts, and other included items allow users to reenact various iconic scenes from Mega Man!

■ Model Specifications:

・The kit includes four interchangeable face parts.

・The Buster can be equipped to the model’s left or right arm.

・The kit includes four interchangeable hands to recreate a variety of situations.

・Includes a long-awaited helmetless head part.

・The new pop out articulation feature in the chest and arms allows for a wider range of motion. The sliding motion and poses while holding the Buster are able to be displayed more naturally.

・Includes Charge Shot effect parts which allow for scenes from the game to be recreated.

・The Charge Shot effect parts can also be used as effect parts for Mega Man's slides and other actions.

・The 3mm connection joint on the model’s back is compatible with separately sold bases from Kotobukiya’s M.S.G series, such as the NEW FLYING BASE and NEW FLYING BASE Plus, allowing for action poses from the game to be displayed.

・The kit is made of multi-colored plastic and contains pre-painted parts, making it easy for users of all levels to build Mega Man as he appears in the game.

■ Included Items:

・Four Interchangeable Face Parts (Default/Looking Forward, Smiling/Looking Left, Shouting/Looking Left, and Teeth Clenched/Looking Right)

・Helmetless Head Part

・Buster

・Four Interchangeable Hand Parts (Closed, Open 1, Open 2, Open 3)

・Charge Shot Effect Parts

4934054037544.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054037544.short: Mega Man X is available as a detailed plastic model kit, featuring interchangeable faces, the X-Buster, hand parts, and effect pieces for charge, dash, and impact shots. Designed for fans, it offers customization and compatibility with M.S.G series bases.
4934054037544.desc:
X, the protagonist of Mega Man X, is here!

With over 32 million units in sales, the Mega Man series is a beloved video game franchise with fans of all generations throughout the world.

Incredibly popular for their fast-paced action and deep storytelling, the games inspired a variety of spinoff games and media, including the Mega Man X series that became a core brand within the franchise.

Now, the protagonist of the series, X, is being released as a plastic model kit for the first time in over 20 years since the release of the first game!

Thanks to the technology of CAD engineering, the character’s proportions, which are based on the character’s appearance after Mega Man X4, are faithfully recreated while maintaining an impressive range of articulation that allows users to recreate a variety of scenes from the games!

The kit includes a generous number of customizable parts, from X’s signature X-Buster to a variety of hand parts and three different face parts. On top of that, the kit also includes a variety of effect parts, allowing users to recreate the dash, charge, and charge buster from the games. 

This impressive kit is a must-have for fans of Mega Man X!

■ Model Specifications:

・The kit includes three interchangeable face parts.

・The X-Buster can be equipped to the model’s left or right arm.

・The kit includes three types of interchangeable hand parts.

・The model’s back features a 3mm connection point, making it compatible with separately sold bases from Kotobukiya’s M.S.G series, such as the NEW FLYING BASE and NEW FLYING BASE Plus.

・Interchangeable Face Parts (Default/Looking Forward, Teeth Clenched/Looking Right, and Shouting/Looking Left)

・X-Buster

・Three Interchangeable Hand Parts (Closed, Open, Support)

・Charge Shot Effect Parts

4934054037773.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits

This color variant of X uses a special iridescent coating that changes color depending on the light, with vibrant shades of light blue, blue, purple, and green that resemble the energy charge effect from the games!

In addition to the updated color scheme, the kit includes two alternate face parts with eyes facing the opposite direction of the parts from the standard version. The standard kit’s clear green “Buster Effect” parts based on the games after Mega Man X4 are changed in the premium version to clear blue plastic to resemble the effect from the first three games in the series. Combine the parts from the two kits to recreate an even wider range of scenes from across the entire Mega Man X series!

・The kit includes three interchangeable face parts.

・The X-Buster can be equipped to the model’s left or right arm.

・The kit includes three interchangeable hand parts.

・The model’s back features a 3mm connection point, making it compatible with separately sold bases from Kotobukiya’s M.S.G series, such as the NEW FLYING BASE and NEW FLYING BASE Plus.

・The charge shot effect parts can be switched out for a dash effect or impact effect, giving users a variety of customizable display options.

・The dash effect part is equipped with a 5mm joint, making it compatible with the arms of separately sold bases from Kotobukiya’s M.S.G series, such as the NEW FLYING BASE and NEW FLYING BASE Plus so they can be used as a display stand.

・The kit is made of multi-colored plastic and contains pre-painted parts, making it easy for users of all levels to build the X as it appears in the game.

・The packaging includes a specially drawn illustration by Mega Man X series character designer Keisuke Mizuno.

■ Included Items:

・Interchangeable Face Parts (Default/Looking Forward, Shouting/Looking Right, and Teeth Clenched/Looking Left)

・X-Buster

・Three Interchangeable Hand Parts (Closed, Open, Support)

・Charge Shot Effect Parts

4934054039814.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054039814.short: Mega Man X3's X returns in Max Armor form as a plastic model kit, featuring interchangeable parts, the Z Saber with optional lighting, and articulation for dynamic poses. Designed for all skill levels, it includes multiple facial expressions, hand parts, and compatibility with previous X model kits.
4934054039814.desc:
X's new power has been awakened: Max Armor version is now available for pre-order!

With over 35 million units in sales, the Mega Man series is a beloved video game franchise with fans of all generations throughout the world. Beloved by fans for their fast-paced action and deep storytelling, the games inspired a variety of spinoff games and media, including the Mega Man X series that became a core brand within the franchise. Now, the protagonist of Mega Man X3, X, is now appearing with newly powered up parts in his Max Armor form as a plastic model kit for the first time in over 25 years!

Thanks to the technology of CAD engineering, the character’s proportions, which are based on the character’s appearance in the game, are faithfully recreated while maintaining an impressive range of articulation that allows users to recreate a variety of scenes from the games!

The powerful Z Saber given to X by his dear friend, Zero, is included in this kit! By adding a Milight 316 (lithium-ion battery with an LED attached) (sold separately) to the Z Saber, you can make the clear blade light up!

Customize this kit with parts from the first X model kit in this series to enjoy recreating snapshot moments from the game of X collecting each piece of armor. Other accessories included in the model kit, such as the Buster, hand parts, three interchangeable facial expressions, and the Z Saber make this model kit perfect for recreating many different situations from the game.

■ Model Specifications:
・The kit includes three interchangeable face parts.
・The Buster can be equipped to the model’s left or right arm.
・The kit includes interchangeable hand parts.
・The model’s back is equipped with a 3mm connection point, making it compatible with separately sold bases from Kotobukiya’s M.S.G. series, such as the New Flying Base and New Flying Base Plus.
・The head, body, arm, and leg parts are interchangeable with previously sold "Mega Man X X", which enables users to recreate X as he is collecting the armor pieces from the game.
・The blade part of the Z Saber is made of clear plastic.
・A Milight 316 (lithium-ion battery with an LED attached) can be inserted into the special Z Saber-holding hand part made for Milights to light up the blade of the Z Saber.
*This part is only compatible with Milight 316 (lithium-ion battery with an LED attached).
・The kit is made of multi-colored plastic and contains pre-painted parts, making it easy for users of all levels to build a model that closely resembles the character’s appearance in the game.
・The packaging includes a specially drawn illustration by Mega Man X Series character designer Keisuke Mizuno.

■ Included Items:
・Interchangeable Face Parts (Default/Looking Forward, Default/Looking Forward 2, and Shouting/Looking Forward)
・Buster
・Four Interchangeable Hand Parts (Closed, Open, Support, Weapon Holding)
・Z Saber

4934054045389.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054045389.short: A plastic model kit of Siren from Xenoblade Chronicles 2, featuring interchangeable arms, a flying base, and detailed wings and halo. Includes decals, a pre-painted face, and multi-color plastic parts.

From Monolith Soft's RPG Xenoblade Chronicles 2, Siren is joining Kotobukiya’s plastic model kit lineup!

Siren's distinct, elegant form in the game is faithfully recreated.

The kit includes interchangeable arms to recreate both dormant and firing poses. A flying base and extra arm to support the firing pose is also included.

4934054049233.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054049233.short: This Mega Man X plastic model kit features Zero in his Black Zero form, with interchangeable parts for poses and expressions, including the Z-Saber with light-up blade effects and options to recreate Fake Zero and dynamic action scenes.
4934054049233.desc:
Zero, one of the most popular characters in the series, unleashes his power as Black Zero! 

With over 35 million units in sales, the Mega Man series is a beloved video game franchise with fans of all generations throughout the world. 

Incredibly popular for their fast-paced action and deep storytelling, the games inspired a variety of spinoff games and media, including the Mega Man X series that became a core brand within the franchise. 

From that series, Zero—the Maverick Hunter, dependable mentor, and friend to the protagonist X—is appearing in his powered-up form, Black Zero, for the first time as a plastic model kit. 

Thanks to the technology of CAD engineering, the character’s proportions, which are based on the character’s appearance in the game, are faithfully recreated while maintaining an impressive range of articulation that allows users to recreate a variety of scenes from the games! 

Zero's iconic weapon, the Z-Saber, comes with four different clear blade effect parts that can light up when used with a Milight 316 (a lithium-ion battery with an LED attached, sold separately)! 

Both clear blue and red parts have been included for the forehead, so users can recreate Fake Zero from Mega Man X2. 

An interchangeable neck and twisted waist are newly added to recreate realistic dash poses. They can also be combined with effect parts to recreate Zero's Rakuhouha pose! 

The kit also comes with a short hair part for an even wider range of dynamic poses. 

Also, use the bonus twisted waist part and short hair in Zero’s color to update the Zero models in your collection! 

Other included accessories such as the Buster, hand parts, three interchangeable facial expressions, and the Z-Saber make this model kit perfect for recreating many different situations from the games. 

Model Specifications: 

・Includes three interchangeable face parts. 

・ The Buster can be equipped to the model's left or right arm. 

・ Includes four interchangeable hand parts. 

・The hands holding the Z-Saber are interchangeable with the separately sold MEGA MAN X X. 

・The Z-Saber can also be mounted to the model's back. 

・Four different Z-Saber effect parts are included. 

・The blade of the Z-Saber is recreated with clear colored material. 

・A Milight 316 (lithium-ion battery with an LED attached) can be inserted into the special Z-Saber hand part made for Milights to light up the blade of the Z-Saber. 

*This part is only compatible with Milight 316 (lithium-ion battery with an LED attached). 

・To display action poses, the model’s back features a 3mm connection point that is compatible with separately sold bases from Kotobukiya’s M.S.G series, such as the NEW FLYING BASE and NEW FLYING BASE Plus. 

・The kit is made of multi-colored plastic and contains pre-painted parts, making it easy for users of all levels to build Zero as he appears in the game. 

・An interchangeable neck and twisted waist are newly added to recreate realistic dash poses. They can be combined with effect parts to recreate Zero's Rakuhouha pose. 

・The packaging includes a specially drawn illustration by Mega Man X series character designer Keisuke Mizuno.  

Included Items:

4934054054411.cats: Plastic Model Kits Model Kit Accessories
4934054054411.short: This kit includes clear blue armor units with a silver internal frame, offering multiple assembly options like wing or defense modes. It features articulated joints, extension mechanisms, and compatible accessories for creative customization with other kits.
4934054054411.desc:
A kit of interconnected clear armor units from the Heavy Weapon Unit series is getting reproduced in “made in Japan” (Kikuchi Seisakusho) quality!!
The concept of this product is creating clear articulated wing armor perfect for character models.

The parts can be assembled in a variety of different combinations such as the beautiful “wing mode” with a sharp silhouette, or “defense mode” as a body-length shield, and can be used to create unique customizations with other kits.

The armor parts are clear blue, and the internal mecha frame is silver. The clear color of the armor gives users a glimpse of the silver frame inside for a beautiful finish on this Heavy Weapon Unit.

This item was developed in cooperation with KIKUCHI SEISAKUSHO CO., LTD., located in Hachioji, Tokyo, with the aspiration to illustrate quality Japanese craftsmanship. 

About KIKUCHI SEISAKUSHO CO., LTD.:
Kikuchi Seisakusho is “a company that provides integrated support for monozukuri” that offers a helping hand for creating new products in all kinds of fields with their package solution system that includes development, design, molding, prototyping, evaluation, and mass production.
Not only do they strive for production efficiency, but their goal is the “creation of a support industry” that provides assistance through crafts. Using their technology and sticking to down-to-earth production, they strive for a society that is considerate, creates helpful products, and flourishes with kindness.

Model Specifications:
■The joint units for connecting the binders are articulated, making it possible to change the angle and create various poses and scenes.
■The binder alone features an open/close mechanic allowing for a variety of silhouettes.
■Each binder features an extension mechanism so users can link one after another in a chain limited only by their imaginations!
■The included clear sword and clear dagger can be stowed on the other side of the binder.
■The 3mm connection joints on the base attachment can be moved up and down allowing it to be equipped to many other kits.
■As the binder itself has a 3mm connection point, it can be used with a flying base and mounted in a stand-alone unit configuration. Use this feature to create cool scenes with binders hovering in the air!

■Connection Base ×1

■Clear Sword ×2
■Clear Dagger ×4

4934054057726.short: The Knight armor enhances third-gen HEXA GEAR for mounted combat, featuring improved survivability, power-assisted artificial muscles, and a versatile mounting arm for weapons and equipment. It includes a large sword, shield, and articulated parts for dynamic posing.
4934054057726.desc:
Model Information:

ARMOR TYPE: KNIGHT

The aim of this project was to develop a new type of armor based on Pawn A1 that would be more specialized for mounted warfare. The idea was to raise the combat capabilities of third-gen HEXA GEAR by having Governors take a more direct role in combat.

Almost all of the top priority design changes were oriented around mounted combat using third-gen HEXA GEAR's open cockpit design. This dramatically improved the survivability of Governors who would otherwise be continually exposed to fire.

The heavy armoring of the body is concentrated on key torso parts. No major changes were made to the limbs, other than the knees and some other protruding parts, in order to maintain mobility when boarding HEXA GEAR.

The power assistance of the artificial muscles in the inner suit were also greatly improved. This was done with the awareness that energy supplies from the HEXA G-R.A.M would be excessively depleted and the machine’s operating time would be shortened, but receiving a higher power output in return. The underlying aim was to improve combat capability with heavy weapons, which Pawn A1 was unable to handle.

This system is conceptually similar to the ""resonant energization"" of Rayblade Impulse and was carried over into the subsequent research on EX ARMOR TYPES by the Hakua Riken Research Institute.

In addition, a major change from Pawn A1 was the addition of a mounting arm. The arm serves as both an extension platform and power assistance and comes standard with the unit. The structure of the unit allows it to be divided or changed for flexible use. Naturally, it is also compatible with other ARMOR TYPES and is able to suspend equipment when used in combination with the KARMA control system, including heavy weapons such as shields and charge cannons, which would normally be placed on board. 

Many of these armor-enhancing components, initially dubbed Pawn A2, were consolidated under the name ""Knight"" and eventually mass-produced and sent out by the Liberty Alliance as ""Armor Type: Knight."" After triumphing over a powerful foe in a gleaming set of new armor, the Governor raises his sword.

Model Specifications: 

■ Attach the Large Sword to the Large Cannon included in GOVERNOR ARMOR TYPE: KNIGHT【NERO】 (sold separately) for an even more enhanced HEXA GEAR weapon. 

■ The Shield uses clear parts to bring out a realistic feel to the model. The grip of the shield can be adjusted to give optimal posing options. Attach to the Mount Arm using its 3mm connectors to enjoy endless assembly options. 

■ Exchange the armor parts on the shield to decrease its defense area.

■ This model is 82mm in size and has 24 points of articulation.

■ This model uses GOVERNOR ARMOR TYPE: PAWN A1 Ver.1.5 as its base and boasts a wide range of articulation. 

■ The Mount Arm included uses a flexible joint part to give the mount more design options and allows for various parts to be attached. 

■ The back pack and abdomen parts include 3mm connecting joints where the Mount Arm can be attached.

■ Use the hard point extension for the forearm to attach various parts.

■ The additional armor on the hips are detachable, making the model adaptable to different situations such as boarding onto a separately sold HEXA GEAR, or simply making the armor on the model more lightweight. Additionally, the said armor can be combined into a small shield and attached onto the forearm using the included hard point.

■ The head is pre-painted. 

*This model kit uses the same color variations as previously released GOVERNOR ARMOR TYPE: PAWN A1 Ver.1.5. 

Included Parts: 

■ Large Sword ×1

■ Shield ×1

■ Mount Arm ×1

■ Hard Point Extension for Forearm ×1

■ 3mm Joint ×1

■ Left and Right Hand Parts (Closed, Open, Weapon Holding)

■ PVC HEXA G-R.A.M. ×1

■ Archive Card ×1

(This item is a reproduction.)

• The weapon holding hand parts can be used with X (sold separately) as well.
• The leg joints from Mega Man X Zero are updated for easier posing.
• The 3mm connection joint on the model’s back makes it compatible with separately sold bases from Kotobukiya’s M.S.G series, such as the New Flying Base and New Flying Base Plus, enabling a display of the model in an action posture in the game.
• The kit is made of multi-colored plastic and contains pre-painted parts, making it easy for users of all levels to build Zero as he appears in the game.
• The packaging includes a specially drawn illustration by Mega Man X series character designer Keisuke Mizuno.

Included Items:

• Three Interchangeable Face Parts (Looking Left/Closed Mouth, Looking Right/Shouting, Looking Forward/Smiling)
• Interchangeable Buster
• Four Interchangeable Hand Parts (Closed, Open, Support, Weapon Holding)

Bonus Parts:

• Clear Head Piece with Dr. Wily's Emblem
• Iron Pipe

4934054060009.short: This set includes four unpainted figures from METAL GEAR SOLID: Solid Snake, Liquid Snake, and two versions of Cyborg Ninja, plus a hangar-themed base. One Cyborg Ninja pose recreates his iconic defeat under METAL GEAR REX.
4934054060009.desc:
Celebrating its 35th anniversary in 2022, Konami’s stealth-action game series METAL GEAR is a popular series with over 60 million units sold.

From the hit game METAL GEAR SOLID comes the first-ever model of the nuclear-armed bipedal tank METAL GEAR REX.

[Set Contents]

• A total of four figures are included: Solid Snake, Liquid Snake, and two versions of Cyborg Ninja.
• Cyborg Ninja’s two figures include one with a standard standing pose, and one that recreates the iconic scene where he is crushed underfoot by METAL GEAR REX.
• A special base designed after the hangar from the series is also included.

[Notes]

*The included figures are unpainted.
*Camouflage pattern decals are not included.
(This item is a reproduction.)

4934054062980.short: Florian and Fuecoco from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet are featured in detailed statues based on illustrations by Hitoshi Ariga. The pair captures Florian's eager expression and Fuecoco's adorable presence with realistic textures and colors.
4934054062980.desc:
*Please note that this product is not to be displayed on the same shelf or fixture unit as Pokémon Trading Card Game products.

Florian and Fuecoco from Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet are joining the lineup!

These statues are based on the illustrations of popular series designer Hitoshi Ariga.

Check out Florian's eager expression as he steps forth on his Treasure Hunt across the Paldea region!

The sight of it will brighten anyone's day ♪

His Uva Academy uniform and backpack have been painted and texturized to give the statues an even more realistic feel.

Happily beaming by Florian's side is Fuecoco, its adorable nature dutifully recreated in statue form.

Add this pair of statues to your team today!

4934054063369.short: This detailed ARTFX+ Darth Vader statue captures his Return of the Jedi appearance, featuring interchangeable parts, textured armor, and a pose-ready design. It stands as a centerpiece for any STAR WARS Saga Collection.
4934054063369.desc:
The Dark Lord of the Sith is back! The latest release in the hit line of smaller scale STAR WARS™ ARTFX+ Statues steps right out of Return of the Jedi: DARTH VADER RETURN OF ANAKIN SKYWALKER ARTFX!  An all new representation of the iconic villain, this Vader collectible joins the elite lineup of your favorite heroes and villains from the original STAR WARS films in the Saga Collection, following great statues like THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK™ version, Boba Fett, C-3PO, and R2-D2.

This Darth Vader collectible is portrayed preparing for his final battle as the Rebel fleet hammers the fully operational Death Star. Updated to match his appearance in RETURN OF THE JEDI™, the fallen Jedi stands with his crimson Lightsaber™ at the ready for both attack and defense.  A tall and imposing figure, Vader is like a coiled viper with his legs slightly bent and his Lightsaber™ held in both hands.  The Dark Lord’s armor is intricately detailed and sculpted perfectly to match its appearance in the film with all of the mechanical and cloth elements distinctly textured.  You can even display Vader in a variety of poses and looks with multiple interchangeable arm parts and head pieces featuring the iconic helmet or the unmasked Anakin Skywalker!  Like all STAR WARS ARTFX+ Statues, he has magnets in his feet for display on the included base. 

ARTFX+ Statues are fun-to-assemble pre-painted snap-fit kits that can be easily put together in seconds without glue or modeling skill.  Darth Vader Statue stands approximately 7.5 inches tall (1/10th scale) and is the perfect centerpiece for your Saga Collection!

*This reproduction will have a different SRP than its previous release.

4934054063376.short: Kotobukiya's ARTFX+ series features a highly detailed 1/10 scale statue of Emperor Palpatine, capturing his menacing Sith presence and regal throne.
4934054063376.desc:
The Emperor of the Galactic Empire returns!

Emperor Palpatine, also known as Darth Sidious, who wreaked havoc as the greatest villain,

reappears in Kotobukiya's Star Wars™ ARTFX+ series.

The wrinkles on his face under his pitch-black robe, ominously glowing eyes characteristic of the

Sith, and the throne he sits on in a dignified pose have all been recreated down to the finest detail

in 1/10 scale.

Add this piece to your collection and enjoy it with the rest of the series!

*This reproduction will have a different SRP than its previous release.

4934054065776.short: The third MY LITTLE PONY BISHOUJO figure features Fluttershy, lovingly sculpted in the BISHOUJO style with detailed hair, dress, and a small pony at her feet. The fourth entry, Rarity, is also announced.
4934054065776.desc:
The third entry in MY LITTLE PONY BISHOUJO line is the kind-hearted Fluttershy!

Characters from the American cultural phenomenon MY LITTLE PONY are joining the BISHOUJO series! The next character to be rendered into the BISHOUJO style by BISHOUJO series illustrator Shunya Yamashita is Fluttershy, a kind-hearted pony who loves plants and animals. 

The sculpting of Fluttershy’s soft pink hair and her flowy sundress are recreated in lifelike detail, and the pony statue sitting quietly at the BISHOUJO’s feet is the embodiment of kindness itself. Like the previous entries in the series, the pony’s long eyelashes are recreated with delicate sculpting, giving the statue an extra level of beauty and detail. Both the BISHOUJO and the pony are so full of detail, you can practically hear them speaking to you in Fluttershy’s soft voice.

After Fluttershy the fourth entry in the MY LITTLE PONY BISHOUJO series is Rarity! Stay tuned for more updates.

MY LITTLE PONY and all related characters are trademarks of Hasbro and are used with permission. © 2019 Hasbro. All Rights Reserved. Licensed by Hasbro.

4934054066209.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054066209.short: The Medarot Metal Beetle model kit features interchangeable visors, effect parts, and dialogue plates for customizable builds. It can be combined with other models in the Medarot series.
4934054066209.desc:
The original Medarot, Metal Beetle comes as a plastic model kit, loaded with parts and features! 

Joining Kotobukiya’s Medarot series as the second entry, is the character synonymous with the Medarot series: Metal Beetle! 

This model comes with a variety of features to recreate the silhouette from the original Medarot series, including 4 visors with different expressions, shooting effect parts, and dialogue plates. 

Parts can be recombined with other models in Kotobukiya’s Medarot series. 

The multi-colored design allows the user to recreate Metal Beetle's heroic in-game appearance just by assembling the kit. 

(This item is a reproduction.)

4934054066254.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054066254.short: Head Scissors is a detailed Medarot model kit featuring spring-loaded weapons, interchangeable parts, and compatibility with other kits in the series. It includes pre-painted components and multiple visors for different scenarios.
4934054066254.desc:
Head Scissors, one of the most popular Medarots of all time, is the third entry in the Medarot model kit series! 

In addition to faithfully recreating the silhouettes of each Medapart, Head Scissors' right arm Chanbara Sword and left arm Picopeco Hammer are both spring-loaded. 

The kit is packed with other features that set it apart from regular Kotobukiya model kits as well, including two types of antennae, dialogue plates, and a Medarot medal. 

Just like in the games, the model's Medaparts are also compatible with other kits in the series. 

Simply assemble to create a unique and new Medarot! 

Includes four pre-painted visors for various situations. 

The kit is also pre-painted in series-accurate colors, so simply build and enjoy recreating scenes from the show and games! 

 

(This item is a reproduction.)

4934054066292.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054066292.short: This premium Mega Man 11 model features an iridescent red coating and effect parts that mimic the game's energy charge effect. It includes interchangeable faces, a Buster, multiple hands, and poseable articulation for dynamic displays.
4934054066292.desc:
A premium version of MEGA MAN 11 Ver. based on the game is here!

This color variant uses a special iridescent coating that changes color depending on the light that resembles the in-game energy charge effect!

The effect parts are also an iridescent red to recreate the look of the Power Gear being used!

The intricate part separation featured in the Mega Man X plastic model kits and the proportions and articulation achieved through CAD technology allows users to assemble Mega Man as if he stepped out of the game!

Furthermore, the inclusion of four interchangeable face parts full of personality, the Buster, impressive Charge Shot effect parts, and other included items allow users to reenact various iconic scenes from Mega Man!

■ Changes from the Standard Version

・The model is coated with pearlescent plating that changes colors depending on the angle.

・The Charge Shot effect parts come in new colors.

　【Standard Color】Blue ⇒ 【Premium Color】Iridescent Red

・The package features a premium version illustration.

■ Model Specifications (Same as Standard Ver.)

・The kit includes four interchangeable face parts.

・The Buster can be equipped to the model’s left or right arm.

・The kit includes four interchangeable hands to recreate a variety of situations.

・Includes a long-awaited helmetless head part.

・The new pop out articulation feature in the chest and arms allows for a wider range of motion. The sliding motion and poses while holding the Buster are able to be displayed more naturally.

・Includes Charge Shot effect parts which allow for scenes from the game to be recreated.

・The Charge Shot effect parts can also be used as effect parts for Mega Man's slides and other actions.

・The 3mm connection joint on the model’s back is compatible with separately sold bases from Kotobukiya’s M.S.G series, such as the NEW FLYING BASE and NEW FLYING BASE Plus, allowing for action poses from the game to be displayed.

・The kit is made of multi-colored plastic and contains pre-painted parts, making it easy for users of all levels to build Mega Man as he appears in the game.

■ Included Items:

・Four Interchangeable Face Parts (Default/Looking Forward, Smiling/Looking Left, Shouting/Looking Left, and Teeth Clenched/Looking Right)

・Helmetless Head Part

・Buster

・Four Interchangeable Hand Parts (Closed, Open 1, Open 2, Open 3)

・Charge Shot Effect Parts

4934054066407.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054066407.short: This premium Mega Man Battle Network model features an iridescent coating that changes color in the light, with green iridescent effects for the Sword and Life Sword. It includes interchangeable face parts, multiple weapon options, and customizable hand parts for assembling dynamic in-game scenes.
4934054066407.desc:
A premium version of Mega Man (Mega Man Battle Network) based on the in-game appearance is here! 

This color variant uses a special iridescent coating that changes color depending on the light to recreate the energy charge effect! The Sword and Life Sword effects are molded in iridescent green to resemble the in-game flashing effect! 

The intricate part separation featured in the Mega Man X plastic model kits and the proportions and articulation achieved through CAD technology allows users to assemble Mega Man as if he stepped out of the game or anime! 

Furthermore, users can customize with the extensive range of included items, such as four expressive face parts, Buster, Cannon, Sword, and Life Sword effect to reenact famous scenes from Mega Man Battle Network! 

■ Changes from the Standard Version 

・The model uses a special iridescent coating that changes colors depending on the light. 

・The Life Sword effect is molded in a different color. 

　【Standard Color】Clear Green ⇒ 【Premium Color】Iridescent Green 

・The package features a premium version illustration. 

■ Model Specifications (Same as Standard Ver.) 

・The kit includes four interchangeable face parts. 

・Buster, Cannon, and Sword can be displayed by replacing the forearm parts. 

・Customizable with interchangeable hand parts included in the kit. 

・Includes two Sword effect parts that feature different lengths. 

・The model is compatible with separately sold bases from Kotobukiya’s M.S.G series, such as the NEW FLYING BASE and NEW FLYING BASE Plus, allowing for action poses to be displayed. 

・The kit is made of multi-colored plastic and contains pre-painted parts, making it easy for users of all levels to assemble Mega Man as he appears in the game. 

■ Included Items: 

・Four Interchangeable Face Parts (Default/Looking Forward, Smiling/Looking Forward, Shouting/ Looking Forward, Masked/Looking Forward) 

・Mega Buster 

・Cannon Forearm Part 

・Sword Forearm Part 

・Three Sets of Interchangeable Hand Parts (Closed, Open 1, Open 2) 

・Two Sword Effects (Long and Short) 

・Life Sword Effect

4934054066605.short: Kotobukiya's third wave features Serena from Pokémon X and Y, styled in her signature outfit with Fennekin by her side. The figure captures her fashionable pose and includes detailed accessories.
4934054066605.desc:
The third wave of Kotobukiya's popular Pokémon figures returns!

Based on an original illustration from Hitoshi Ariga, the fabulous female protagonist of Pokémon X and Pokémon Y, Serena, is here!

To capture Serena's fashionable image, her clothes including her pleated skirt, bag, and accessories have all been faithfully recreated!

Her pose makes her look like she's on a runway. Fennekin is striking a pose, proudly showing its flames off next to Serena.

Add them to your collection today!

4934054067121.short: Princess Cadance's costume, designed by Shunya Yamashita, features an imperial-style dress with clear plastic, gradation painting, and sparkling gold accessories, capturing her regal and loving nature. Her detailed pony form can be displayed alone or with other MY LITTLE PONY BISHOUJO characters.
4934054067121.desc:
Princess Cadance became close to the young Twilight Sparkle as her foal-sitter, and now she is her sister-in-law.

As she is known for her tales of overcoming hardships with the power of love, her costume is based on an imperial style dress reminiscent of the goddess of love.

This original design is by well-known series artist Shunya Yamashita, and is packed to the brim with BISHOUJO details. The dress is made of clear plastic material and features gradation painting to give a mystical impression, and the gold accessories sparkle with cute and gorgeous style. Her bright and colorful hair is recreated with pearl paint. Her pony form, created with a more mature silhouette and atmosphere than the Mane 6, can be displayed together or independently in a variety of scenarios. Her long eyelashes are also a sight to behold!

Her arch-nemesis, Queen Chrysalis, is right around the corner! While Princess Cadance makes a great companion for Twilight Sparkle, she also looks great with others from the MY LITTLE PONY BISHOUJO series.

4934054067138.short: Queen Chrysalis, the villainous changeling queen, joins the MY LITTLE PONY BISHOUJO series in a detailed design by Shunya Yamashita. She features a mysterious, gloomy look with unique changeling elements and can be displayed alone or with other characters.
4934054067138.desc:
Queen of the changelings, creatures who feed on love, and the villain who plotted to invade Equestria, Queen Chrysalis will now be joining the MY LITTLE PONY BISHOUJO lineup!

This original design is by well-known series artist Shunya Yamashita, and is packed to the brim with BISHOUJO details. The figure exudes a slender, mysterious, and gloomy aura.

Her long legs are enhanced by leather pants coordinated with platform boots for a unique silhouette.

With a finish reminiscent of insect wings, the loincloth and scarf incorporate the distinctive features of the changelings.

Her changeling form, recreated down to the holes in her feet, has a slightly different silhouette than that of the ponies, and can be displayed together or independently in a variety of scenarios.

Be sure to display her alongside the new Princess Cadence and Princess Celestia, or other characters from the MY LITTLE PONY BISHOUJO series.

4934054067701.short: Kotobukiya's latest Pokémon figure features Gloria with Sobble from Sword and Shield, capturing detailed poses and textures from the game. The figure highlights Sobble's tear and Gloria's outfit with intricate design.
4934054067701.desc:
The return of Gloria from Pokémon Sword and Shield!

The latest duo to join Kotobukiya’s series of Pokémon figures is Gloria with Sobble from Pokémon Sword and Shield!

Based on an illustration by Hitoshi Ariga, Yuuri’s posing perfectly captures the way she looks out over the vast landscape of the Galar Region. The texture of the leather Boston bag, the fluffiness of the knit hoodie, and the checkered pattern of the socks are all aspects that can only be seen in detail as a figure.

The single tear trickling down from Sobbles’s eye and the puddle of tears is expressed with clear parts.

Be sure to get your hands on this figure to enjoy all of the minute details of the figure! ♪

*This rerelease will have a different SRP than its first release.

4934054067718.short: Victor and Scorbunny from Pokémon Sword and Shield are captured in dynamic poses, with detailed textures and expressions, based on an illustration by Hitoshi Ariga.
4934054067718.desc:
Victor and Scorbunny from Pokémon Sword Shield are joining the lineup!

Victor is posed pointing off into the distance, representing the great adventure he and his companions are about to embark on in the Galar region.

Based on an illustration by Hitoshi Ariga, the figure is packed with details, from the texture of the leather backpack to the checked pattern of his pockets and the three-dimensional expression of the distressed jeans. Everything has been captured in a way only possible with a figure.

The energetic Scorbunny that looks like it could shoot off at any second also features a dynamic pose! The fire around its feet is expressed with clear parts.

Add them to your collection and enjoy all the details up close! ♪

4934054069835.short: Celebrate the 25th anniversary of Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters with this detailed ARTFX J figure of Yami Yugi, designed after a new illustration by Takahiro Kagami. Perfectly capturing his regal presence, it can be displayed with or without his jacket.
4934054069835.desc:
The valiant duelists who’ve fought countless fierce battles return once more!

Celebrating the 25th anniversary of the legendary anime Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters, Yami Yugi joins the ARTFX J series with an all-new sculpt!

This figure captures Yami Yugi in a dignified stance, radiating the presence of the Pharaoh, based on an all-new anniversary illustration by animator Takahiro Kagami. Every detail, down to the fingertips, has been meticulously crafted to capture the stylish and powerful essence of Kagami’s artwork. The figure can also be displayed with and without his school uniform jacket.

From Kotobukiya, renowned for its extensive lineup of Yu-Gi-Oh! figures, this new figure can truly be called the definitive edition.

Display him with the simultaneously announced Yugi Muto back-to-back as trusted partners, or face-to-face in a duel as Yugi versus the Pharaoh!

Seto Kaiba and Joey Wheeler are also coming!

Add these passionate duelists, beloved across generations, to your collection today!

4934054069842.short: To celebrate the 25th anniversary of Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters, Kotobukiya releases a meticulously detailed Yugi Muto figure, inspired by an original illustration and capturing his dynamic, courageous spirit. Display him with Yami Yugi and other upcoming duelists in your collection.
4934054069842.desc:
The valiant duelists who’ve fought countless fierce battles return once more!

Celebrating the 25th anniversary of the legendary anime Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters, the long-awaited Yugi Muto joins the ARTFX J series!

This figure captures Yugi in a dynamic pose that reflects his growth alongside his other self and his courage in battle, inspired by an all-new anniversary illustration by animator Takahiro Kagami. Every detail, down to the fingertips, has been meticulously crafted to capture the stylish and powerful essence of Kagami’s artwork.

From Kotobukiya, renowned for its extensive lineup of Yu-Gi-Oh! figures, this new figure can truly be called the definitive edition.

Display him with the simultaneously announced Yami Yugi back-to-back as trusted partners, or face-to-face in a duel as Yugi versus the Pharaoh!

Seto Kaiba and Joey Wheeler are also coming!

Add these passionate duelists, beloved across generations, to your collection today!

4934054069880.short: Kotobukiya's Freddy Krueger Bishoujo Statue features a unique design by Shunya Yamashita, showcasing Freddy in her iconic sweater, hat, and glove, with a blood-colored base for striking display.
4934054069880.desc:
Kotobukiya brings a bold new direction to their popular series of Bishoujo Statues with the Freddy Krueger Bishoujo Statue.

Based on a new character interpretation by master illustrator Shunya Yamashita, Freddy wears Freddy Krueger's iconic sweater, hat, and bladed glove.

Whether in your dreams or in your nightmares, this Bishoujo statue is sure to make a big impression with her great looks and blood colored base. Standing 18 cm (over 7 inches) tall in 1/7 scale, Freddy is a great addition to your Bishojo collection. Freddy makes for a screaming display on her own, and looks even better alongside the Jason bishoujo!

The reproduction version includes a renewed statue base and package design.

4934054070022.short: Jason Voorhees is reimagined as a bishoujo with her signature hockey mask and weapons, part of a horror-themed series. The statue features a removable axe and machete, and a metal base inspired by Crystal Lake.
4934054070022.desc:
Can’t wait for Friday the 13th!? Jason arrives as a BISHOUJO! 

 

Jason Voorhees marks the beginning of the HORROR BISHOUJO series in which bloodthirsty killers are transformed into BISHOUJO through illustrator Shunya Yamashita’s designs! 

 

Jason Voorhees from Friday the 13th comes to life with her iconic hockey mask on the side of her head, complete with a formidable atmosphere that brings forth the original power of the character. Her well-trained, ripped abs are yet another highlight of this piece! The axe and machete held in her hands can be removed so the statue can be displayed according to the space available. 

 

The base is inspired by a puddle near the shores of Crystal Lake, and is made of metal to provide better stability. Magnets on the feet allow the statue to be fixed anywhere on the base.

 

The scale and base are designed to be displayed with the renewed reproduction of FREDDY VS. JASON FREDDY KRUEGER BISHOUJO STATUE. Enjoy the most terrifying team of Freddy vs. Jason by displaying the two statues side by side!

4934054071654.short: Calem from Pokémon X and Y is captured in detailed 3D, featuring textured clothing and clear plastic sunglasses. The figure includes a poseable Froakie with detailed bubbles on its back.
4934054071654.desc:
Holding the bill of his cap, Calem from Pokémon X and Pokémon Y joins the lineup!

Based on the illustrations of popular series designer Hitoshi Ariga, the figure is packed with details faithfully recreated in 3D, from his textured boots and patterned jacket to his sunglasses’ lenses that are made with clear plastic parts.

The bubbles on Froakie’s back also need to be seen up close to be truly appreciated!

Add them to your collection and enjoy all the details!

4934054073948.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054073948.short: Masaki Apsy-designed CAST figure, originally released as a resin kit and later as a 1/12 scale model, features interchangeable hand parts, directional eyes, and game-accurate stickers. Based on Vermilion Guardian Shiki from Phantasy Star Online 2.
4934054073948.desc:
Introducing an all-new CAST designed and sculpted by Masaki Apsy!

Created by sculptor Masaki Apsy and first released as a resin cast kit at Wonder Festival 2003 Summer, RAcaseal then received a 1/12 scale model kit in May 2011.

From there, with the new setting of Phantasy Star Online 2, in August 2015 a new CAST designed and sculpted by Masaki Apsy was released under the name Vermilion Guardian Shiki.

• The included stickers allow for a model faithful to the original game simply by assembling and applying.

• Includes nine sets of unique hand parts.

• Includes three pre-painted eye parts looking different directions.

Experience the origins of the action figure scene alongside the latest character and action figure technical designs of Masaki Apsy.

*This product is a reproduction. It does not include the ""Phantasy Star Online 2 PC Installation DVD"" or "In-Game Item Codes."

4934054076260.short: Kotobukiya's OSHI WORKS series brings affordable, poseable figures of beloved characters, like Blue-Eyes White Dragon, with crisp paint and a display-friendly base.
4934054076260.desc:
Affordable, Collectible and FUN! Introducing OSHI WORKS, a new series from Kotobukiya! Based on "oshi", the Japanese word for favorite, OSHI WORKS is all about bringing your beloved characters to life at affordable prices. Whether you're just starting your figure collection or you're a seasoned collector looking for something more casual, OSHI WORKS suits all kinds of “oshi” fans. Each figure comes on a standardized square base that makes it easy to collect and display, so they can be shown from every angle. Of course, Kotobukiya will never compromise on our legendary quality and crisp paintwork, even while maintaining wallet-friendly prices. Display your OSHI WORKS figures alongside your other merch or start a brand-new collection with Kotobukiya's new series!

Affordable, Collectible and FUN! Blue-Eyes White Dragon from Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters joins the OSHI WORKS series, measuring over 250 mm tall and 300 mm wide! The neck, shoulders, thighs, and support rod all feature round joints, allowing for a variety of poses to suit different display spaces.

[Size]

• Approx. 250 mm tall (Non-Scale)

[Product Material]

• PVC・ABS

[Included Items]

• Figure (Partially Assembled)
• Dedicated Base

[Production Cooperation]

• THOUSAND INC.

4934054076277.short: Kotobukiya's OSHI WORKS series brings beloved characters to life with affordable, high-quality figures on standardized bases for easy display. This Yu-Gi-Oh! Buster Blader figure includes a magnetic base and crisp detailing.

4934054076321.short: Kotobukiya's OSHI WORKS series features an affordable, collectible Mai Valentine from Yu-Gi-Oh! on a square base for easy display, with high-quality paint and magnetic assembly.

4934054076376.cats: Plastic Model Kits Character Model Kits
4934054076376.short: A GRANDE SCALE plastic model of Gene from Phantasy Star Online 2 es in her Stellainnocent outfit, featuring articulated posing, pre-painted face options, and poseable Fossil Tricks weapon.
4934054076376.desc:
From Phantasy Star Online 2 es, the main heroine Gene arrives in GRANDE SCALE!

At approximately 25cm and in her Stellainnocent outfit, Gene from Phantasy Star Online 2 es joins the GRANDE SCALE plastic model lineup!

The original, detailed Kotobukiya CAD data has been enlarged to GRANDE SCALE.

The model’s sculpting faithfully recreates the character’s appearance from the game, and thanks to the use of CAD technology, boasts an excellent range of articulation that makes it easy to recreate poses in illustrations seen throughout the game.

■ Features unique to GRANDE SCALE models

Due to the model's larger size, the division of colors and parts has been improved!

Fans can enjoy Gene at a higher quality!

Model Specifications:

・The kit includes three face parts. (Default/Looking Forward, Smiling/Looking Right, and Winking) *The Default/Looking Forward face has been newly sculpted.

・The three face parts are pre-painted, allowing users to build a model that closely resembles the character illustration.

・The wrists are articulated with ball joints that allow for a variety of poses.

・The model kit includes five sets of PVC hand parts.

・The included Fossil Tricks has wings that are articulated, allowing it to be recreated while sheathed or with its wings out. Clear blades can be attached when the weapon is deployed.

・Attachment parts are included to more firmly attach the Fossil Tricks to the model's wrists.

・Attachment parts can be used to mount Fossil Tricks to the waist.

【What is GRANDE SCALE?】

GRANDE SCALE is an all-new model kit series that scales up the original Kotobukiya CAD data of models to a larger, even more impressive size.

The kit combines all the great features of a larger model, from ease of assembly and painting to range of play and poseability.
